virtues.ar: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ أَنَّهَا رُقْيَةٌ
virtues.en: The Prophet approved Al-Fatihah as a ruqya: 'And how did you know it is a ruqya?'
virtues.sw: Mtume aliikubali Al-Fatiha kuwa ruqyah: 'Na umejuaje kwamba hiyo ni ruqyah?'

virtues.ar: لَنْ يَزَالَ عَلَيْكَ مِنَ اللَّهِ حَافِظٌ وَلاَ يَقْرَبَنَّكَ شَيْطَانٌ حَتَّى تُصْبِحَ
virtues.en: When you go to bed and recite it, a guardian from Allah will remain with you and no devil will come near you until morning.
virtues.sw: Ukienda kulala ukaisoma, utaendelea kuwa na mlinzi kutoka kwa Allah na shetani hatakukaribia mpaka asubuhi.

name.en: The last two verses of Al-Baqarah

virtues.ar: مَنْ قَرَأَ بِالآيَتَيْنِ مِنْ آخِرِ سُورَةِ الْبَقَرَةِ فِي لَيْلَةٍ كَفَتَاهُ
virtues.en: Whoever recites the last two verses of Al-Baqarah at night, they will suffice him.
virtues.sw: Atakayesoma aya mbili za mwisho za Suratul-Baqarah usiku, zitamtosheleza.

virtues.ar: وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ إِنَّهَا لَتَعْدِلُ ثُلُثَ الْقُرْآنِ
virtues.en: By the One in whose hand is my soul, it is equal to a third of the Quran.
virtues.sw: Naapa kwa Yule ambaye nafsi yangu iko mkononi Mwake, hakika (sura hii) inalingana na theluthi ya Qur'an.

virtues.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ آيَاتٍ أُنْزِلَتِ اللَّيْلَةَ لَمْ يُرَ مِثْلُهُنَّ قَطُّ
virtues.en: Have you not seen verses revealed tonight, the like of which has never been seen? (Al-Falaq and An-Nas)
virtues.sw: Je, hujaona aya zilizoteremshwa usiku huu, ambazo hazijawahi kuonekana mfano wake kamwe? (Al-Falaq na An-Naas)

virtues.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ آيَاتٍ أُنْزِلَتِ اللَّيْلَةَ لَمْ يُرَ مِثْلُهُنَّ قَطُّ
virtues.en: Have you not seen verses revealed tonight, the like of which has never been seen? (Al-Falaq and An-Nas)
virtues.sw: Je, hujaona aya zilizoteremshwa usiku huu, ambazo hazijawahi kuonekana mfano wake kamwe? (Al-Falaq na An-Naas)

duas.ar: بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ أَرْقِيكَ، مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ يُؤْذِيكَ، مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ نَفْسٍ أَوْ عَيْنِ حَاسِدٍ، اللَّهُ يَشْفِيكَ، بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ أَرْقِيكَ
duas.tr: Bismillaahi arqiika, min kulli shay'in yu'dhiika, min sharri kulli nafsin aw 'ayni haasidin, Allaahu yashfiika, bismillaahi arqiika.
duas.en: In the name of Allah I recite ruqya over you, from everything that harms you, from the evil of every soul or envious eye. May Allah heal you. In the name of Allah I recite ruqya over you.
duas.sw: Kwa jina la Allah ninakusomea ruqyah dhidi ya kila kinachokuudhi, na dhidi ya shari ya kila nafsi au jicho la mwenye husuda. Allah akuponye; kwa jina la Allah ninakusomea ruqyah.

note.en: Jibril recited this over the Prophet when he was ill. When reciting over yourself you may say 'Bismillaahi arqii nafsii' as your own supplication; that is changing the words to fit who you mean, not the exact wording of the hadith.
note.sw: Jibril alimsomea Mtume dua hii alipokuwa mgonjwa. Unapojisomea mwenyewe, unaweza kusema 'Bismillaahi arqii nafsii' kama dua yako binafsi; huo ni ubadilishaji wa maneno kulingana na unayemkusudia, si lafudhi ileile ya hadith.

duas.ar: أَذْهِبِ الْبَاسَ رَبَّ النَّاسِ، وَاشْفِ أَنْتَ الشَّافِي، لاَ شِفَاءَ إِلاَّ شِفَاؤُكَ، شِفَاءً لاَ يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
duas.tr: Adh-hibil-ba'sa Rabban-naas, washfi Antash-Shaafii, laa shifaa'a illaa shifaa'uk, shifaa'an laa yughaadiru saqamaa.
duas.en: Remove the harm, O Lord of mankind, and heal, You are the Healer. There is no healing except Your healing, a healing that leaves no illness behind.
duas.sw: Ondoa maradhi, Mola wa watu. Ponya, kwani Wewe ndiye Mponyaji. Hakuna uponyaji isipokuwa uponyaji Wako, uponyaji usioacha maradhi.

note.en: The Prophet said this when visiting a sick person, wiping over them with his right hand.
note.sw: Mtume alikuwa akisema dua hii alipomtembelea mgonjwa, akimpangusa kwa mkono wake wa kulia.

duas.ar: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النَّاسِ أَذْهِبِ الْبَاسَ، اشْفِهِ وَأَنْتَ الشَّافِي، لاَ شِفَاءَ إِلاَّ شِفَاؤُكَ، شِفَاءً لاَ يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
duas.tr: Allaahumma Rabban-naas, adh-hibil-ba's, ishfihi wa Antash-Shaafii, laa shifaa'a illaa shifaa'uk, shifaa'an laa yughaadiru saqamaa.
duas.en: O Allah, Lord of mankind, remove the harm and heal him, for You are the Healer. There is no healing except Your healing, a healing that leaves no illness behind.
duas.sw: Ee Allah, Mola wa watu, ondoa maradhi na umponye, kwani Wewe ndiye Mponyaji. Hakuna uponyaji isipokuwa uponyaji Wako, uponyaji usioacha maradhi.

note.en: The Prophet said this while wiping over a member of his family with his right hand. For a woman, 'ishfihaa' (heal her) changes only the pronoun.
note.sw: Mtume alisema dua hii akimpangusa mmoja wa watu wa familia yake kwa mkono wa kulia. Kwa mwanamke, 'ishfihaa' (mponye yeye) hubadilisha kiwakilishi tu.

duas.ar: بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ
duas.tr: Bismillaah.
duas.en: In the name of Allah.
duas.sw: Kwa jina la Allah.

note.en: Put your hand on the part of your body that hurts and say this three times, then the next dua seven times.
note.sw: Weka mkono wako juu ya sehemu ya mwili inayouma na useme hivi mara tatu, kisha dua inayofuata mara saba.

title.en: Hand on the pain: seeking refuge

duas.ar: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ
duas.tr: A'uudhu billaahi wa qudratihi min sharri maa ajidu wa uhaadhir.
duas.en: I seek refuge in Allah and His power from the evil of what I feel and what I fear.
duas.sw: Najikinga kwa Allah na uwezo Wake dhidi ya shari ya ninachokihisi na ninachokihofia.

note.en: Say it seven times with your hand still on the place of pain.
note.sw: Sema mara saba huku mkono wako ukiwa bado juu ya sehemu inayouma.

duas.ar: أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ أَنْ يَشْفِيَكَ
duas.tr: As'alullaahal-'Adhiim, Rabbal-'Arshil-'Adhiim, an yashfiyak.
duas.en: I ask Allah the Mighty, Lord of the Mighty Throne, to heal you.
duas.sw: Namwomba Allah Mtukufu, Mola wa Arshi tukufu, akuponye.

virtues.ar: مَنْ عَادَ مَرِيضًا لَمْ يَحْضُرْ أَجَلُهُ فَقَالَ عِنْدَهُ سَبْعَ مِرَارٍ أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ أَنْ يَشْفِيَكَ إِلاَّ عَافَاهُ اللَّهُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ الْمَرَضِ
virtues.en: Whoever visits a sick person whose time has not come and says it seven times beside him, Allah will cure him of that illness.
virtues.sw: Atakayemtembelea mgonjwa ambaye muda wake haujafika na akasema hivi mara saba karibu naye, Allah atamponya ugonjwa huo.

duas.ar: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ، وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لاَمَّةٍ
duas.tr: A'uudhu bikalimaatillaahit-taammah, min kulli shaytaanin wa haammah, wa min kulli 'aynin laammah.
duas.en: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from every devil and every poisonous creature, and from every harmful eye.
duas.sw: Najikinga kwa maneno kamili ya Allah dhidi ya kila shetani na kila mdudu mwenye sumu, na dhidi ya kila jicho baya.

note.en: The Prophet sought protection for al-Hasan and al-Husayn with these words, and said Ibrahim used them for Isma'il and Ishaq.
note.sw: Mtume aliwaombea kinga al-Hasan na al-Husayn kwa maneno haya, na akasema Ibrahim aliwaombea nayo Ismail na Is-haq.

virtues.ar: إِنَّ أَبَاكُمَا كَانَ يُعَوِّذُ بِهَا إِسْمَاعِيلَ وَإِسْحَاقَ
virtues.en: Your father (Ibrahim) used to seek protection with these words for Isma'il and Ishaq.
virtues.sw: Baba yenu (Ibrahim) alikuwa akiwaombea kinga Ismail na Is-haq kwa maneno haya.

duas.ar: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
duas.tr: A'uudhu bikalimaatillaahit-taammaati min sharri maa khalaq.
duas.en: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
duas.sw: Najikinga kwa maneno kamili ya Allah dhidi ya shari ya alichokiumba.

virtues.ar: مَنْ نَزَلَ مَنْزِلاً ثُمَّ قَالَ أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ لَمْ يَضُرُّهُ شَىْءٌ حَتَّى يَرْتَحِلَ مِنْ مَنْزِلِهِ ذَلِكَ
virtues.en: Whoever stops at a place and says it, nothing will harm him until he leaves that place.
virtues.sw: Atakayeshuka mahali kisha akasema hivi, hakuna kitakachomdhuru mpaka aondoke mahali hapo.

virtues.ar: مَنْ قَالَ حِينَ يُمْسِي ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ لَمْ يَضُرَّهُ حُمَةٌ تِلْكَ اللَّيْلَةَ
virtues.en: Whoever says it three times in the evening, no sting will harm him that night.
virtues.sw: Atakayesema mara tatu jioni, hakuna sumu itakayomdhuru usiku huo.

title.en: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing harms
title.sw: Kwa jina la Allah ambaye hakuna kinachodhuru pamoja na jina Lake

duas.ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لاَ يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الأَرْضِ وَلاَ فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
duas.tr: Bismillaahil-ladhii laa yadurru ma'asmihi shay'un fil-ardi wa laa fis-samaa'i wa Huwas-Samii'ul-'Aliim.
duas.en: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in the heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
duas.sw: Kwa jina la Allah ambaye pamoja na jina Lake hakuna kitu kinachodhuru ardhini wala mbinguni, Naye ndiye Msikivu, Mjuzi.

virtues.ar: ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ لَمْ تُصِبْهُ فَجْأَةُ بَلاَءٍ حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ وَمَنْ قَالَهَا حِينَ يُصْبِحُ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ لَمْ تُصِبْهُ فَجْأَةُ بَلاَءٍ حَتَّى يُمْسِيَ
virtues.en: Whoever says it three times in the evening will not be struck by a sudden affliction until morning, and whoever says it three times in the morning will not be struck by a sudden affliction until evening.
virtues.sw: Atakayesema mara tatu jioni hatapatwa na balaa la ghafla mpaka asubuhi, na atakayesema mara tatu asubuhi hatapatwa na balaa la ghafla mpaka jioni.

title.en: For well-being of body, hearing and sight
title.sw: Kuomba afya ya mwili, usikivu na macho

duas.ar: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
duas.tr: Allaahumma 'aafinii fii badanii, Allaahumma 'aafinii fii sam'ii, Allaahumma 'aafinii fii basarii, laa ilaaha illaa Ant.
duas.en: O Allah, grant me well-being in my body. O Allah, grant me well-being in my hearing. O Allah, grant me well-being in my sight. There is none worthy of worship except You.
duas.sw: Ee Allah, nipe afya katika mwili wangu. Ee Allah, nipe afya katika usikivu wangu. Ee Allah, nipe afya katika macho yangu. Hakuna mola apasaye kuabudiwa ila Wewe.

note.en: Abu Bakrah repeated it three times in the morning and three times in the evening, saying he heard the Prophet supplicate with it.
note.sw: Abu Bakrah aliirudia mara tatu asubuhi na mara tatu jioni, akisema alimsikia Mtume akiomba kwayo.

virtues.ar: إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدْعُو بِهِنَّ فَأَنَا أُحِبُّ أَنْ أَسْتَنَّ بِسُنَّتِهِ
virtues.en: Abu Bakrah said: I heard the Messenger of Allah supplicate with these, and I love to follow his Sunnah.
virtues.sw: Abu Bakrah alisema: Nilimsikia Mtume wa Allah akiomba kwa dua hizi, nami napenda kufuata Sunnah yake.

fadl_note.en: You ask Allah for well-being in your body, your hearing and your sight.
fadl_note.sw: Unamwomba Allah afya katika mwili wako, usikivu wako na macho yako.

duas.ar: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ، وَرَبُّ الأَرْضِ، وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ
duas.tr: Laa ilaaha illallaahul-'Adhiimul-Haliim, laa ilaaha illallaahu Rabbul-'Arshil-'Adhiim, laa ilaaha illallaahu Rabbus-samaawaati wa Rabbul-ardi wa Rabbul-'Arshil-Kariim.
duas.en: There is none worthy of worship except Allah, the Mighty, the Forbearing. There is none worthy of worship except Allah, Lord of the Mighty Throne. There is none worthy of worship except Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth and Lord of the Noble Throne.
duas.sw: Hakuna mola apasaye kuabudiwa ila Allah, Mtukufu, Mpole. Hakuna mola apasaye kuabudiwa ila Allah, Mola wa Arshi tukufu. Hakuna mola apasaye kuabudiwa ila Allah, Mola wa mbingu, Mola wa ardhi na Mola wa Arshi tukufu.

note.en: The Prophet used to say this at times of distress.
note.sw: Mtume alikuwa akisema hivi wakati wa dhiki.

duas.ar: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
duas.tr: Laa ilaaha illaa Anta, subhaanaka, innii kuntu minadh-dhaalimiin.
duas.en: There is none worthy of worship except You. Glory be to You. Truly I have been among the wrongdoers.
duas.sw: Hakuna mola apasaye kuabudiwa ila Wewe, Umetakasika. Hakika mimi nimekuwa miongoni mwa waliodhulumu nafsi zao.

note.en: Yunus called with it in the belly of the whale.
note.sw: Yunus aliomba kwayo akiwa tumboni mwa samaki.

virtues.ar: فَإِنَّهُ لَمْ يَدْعُ بِهَا رَجُلٌ مُسْلِمٌ فِي شَيْءٍ قَطُّ إِلاَّ اسْتَجَابَ اللَّهُ لَهُ
virtues.en: No Muslim ever calls upon Allah with it for anything except that Allah answers him.
virtues.sw: Hakuna Muislamu anayeomba kwayo jambo lolote isipokuwa Allah humjibu.

duas.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ، وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
duas.tr: Allaahumma innii a'uudhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan, wal-'ajzi wal-kasal, wal-jubni wal-bukhl, wa dala'id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijaal.
duas.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief, from incapacity and laziness, from cowardice and miserliness, from the burden of debt and from being overpowered by men.
duas.sw: Ee Allah, najikinga Kwako dhidi ya wasiwasi na huzuni, udhaifu na uvivu, woga na ubahili, uzito wa deni na kushindwa na watu.

duas.ar: اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو فَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
duas.tr: Allaahumma rahmataka arjuu, falaa takilnii ilaa nafsii tarfata 'ayn, wa aslih lii sha'nii kullah, laa ilaaha illaa Ant.
duas.en: O Allah, it is Your mercy that I hope for, so do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye, and set right all my affairs. There is none worthy of worship except You.
duas.sw: Ee Allah, rehema Yako ndiyo ninayoitarajia, basi usiniachie nafsi yangu hata kwa kupepesa jicho, na unitengenezee mambo yangu yote. Hakuna mola apasaye kuabudiwa ila Wewe.

title.en: With a little soil and saliva

duas.ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تُرْبَةُ أَرْضِنَا، بِرِيقَةِ بَعْضِنَا، يُشْفَى سَقِيمُنَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّنَا
duas.tr: Bismillaah, turbatu ardinaa, biriiqati ba'dinaa, yushfaa saqiimunaa bi-idhni Rabbinaa.
duas.en: In the name of Allah, the soil of our land, with the saliva of some of us, our sick one is healed by the permission of our Lord.
duas.sw: Kwa jina la Allah, udongo wa ardhi yetu, pamoja na mate ya baadhi yetu, mgonjwa wetu huponywa kwa idhini ya Mola wetu.

note.en: The Prophet said this for a sick person. Scholars such as an-Nawawi explained that he put a little of his saliva on his finger, touched the earth with it, then wiped the place of the wound or pain.
note.sw: Mtume alisema hivi kwa mgonjwa. Wanachuoni kama an-Nawawi walieleza kwamba aliweka mate kidogo kwenye kidole chake, akagusa ardhi nacho, kisha akapangusa sehemu ya jeraha au maumivu.

duas.ar: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهَا، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ
duas.tr: Amsaynaa wa amsal-mulku lillaah, wal-hamdu lillaah, laa ilaaha illallaahu wahdahu laa shariika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa Huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadiir. Rabbi as'aluka khayra maa fii haadhihil-laylati wa khayra maa ba'dahaa, wa a'uudhu bika min sharri maa fii haadhihil-laylati wa sharri maa ba'dahaa. Rabbi a'uudhu bika minal-kasali wa suu'il-kibar. Rabbi a'uudhu bika min 'adhaabin fin-naari wa 'adhaabin fil-qabr.
duas.en: We have reached the evening and the dominion belongs to Allah, and all praise is for Allah. There is none worthy of worship except Allah alone, without partner; to Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He is able to do all things. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this night and the good of what comes after it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this night and the evil of what comes after it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and the misery of old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from punishment in the Fire and punishment in the grave.
duas.sw: Tumeingia jioni na ufalme ni wa Allah, na sifa zote njema ni za Allah. Hakuna mola apasaye kuabudiwa ila Allah peke Yake, hana mshirika; ufalme ni Wake na sifa njema ni Zake, Naye ni Muweza wa kila kitu. Mola wangu, nakuomba kheri ya usiku huu na kheri ya yanayokuja baada yake, na najikinga Kwako dhidi ya shari ya usiku huu na shari ya yanayokuja baada yake. Mola wangu, najikinga Kwako dhidi ya uvivu na ubaya wa uzee. Mola wangu, najikinga Kwako dhidi ya adhabu ya Motoni na adhabu ya kaburini.

note.en: The Prophet said this when evening came.
note.sw: Mtume alikuwa akisema hivi jioni ilipoingia.

fadl_note.en: No particular reward is mentioned for it; it is what the Prophet said every evening and morning, and following his Sunnah is itself the virtue. In it you ask for the good of the night and seek refuge from laziness, the misery of old age, and the punishment of the Fire and the grave.
fadl_note.sw: Hakuna malipo maalumu yaliyotajwa kwa dua hii; ni dua aliyokuwa akiisema Mtume kila jioni na asubuhi, na kufuata Sunnah yake ndiyo fadhila yenyewe. Ndani yake unaomba kheri ya usiku na kujikinga na uvivu, ubaya wa uzee, na adhabu ya Moto na ya kaburi.

duas.ar: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ
duas.tr: Asbahnaa wa asbahal-mulku lillaah, wal-hamdu lillaah, laa ilaaha illallaahu wahdahu laa shariika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa Huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadiir. Rabbi as'aluka khayra maa fii haadhal-yawmi wa khayra maa ba'dah, wa a'uudhu bika min sharri maa fii haadhal-yawmi wa sharri maa ba'dah. Rabbi a'uudhu bika minal-kasali wa suu'il-kibar. Rabbi a'uudhu bika min 'adhaabin fin-naari wa 'adhaabin fil-qabr.
duas.en: We have reached the morning and the dominion belongs to Allah, and all praise is for Allah. There is none worthy of worship except Allah alone, without partner; to Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He is able to do all things. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this day and the good of what comes after it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil of what comes after it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and the misery of old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from punishment in the Fire and punishment in the grave.
duas.sw: Tumeingia asubuhi na ufalme ni wa Allah, na sifa zote njema ni za Allah. Hakuna mola apasaye kuabudiwa ila Allah peke Yake, hana mshirika; ufalme ni Wake na sifa njema ni Zake, Naye ni Muweza wa kila kitu. Mola wangu, nakuomba kheri ya siku hii na kheri ya yanayokuja baada yake, na najikinga Kwako dhidi ya shari ya siku hii na shari ya yanayokuja baada yake. Mola wangu, najikinga Kwako dhidi ya uvivu na ubaya wa uzee. Mola wangu, najikinga Kwako dhidi ya adhabu ya Motoni na adhabu ya kaburini.

note.en: The hadith says that in the morning the Prophet said the same, beginning 'asbahna wa asbaha al-mulku lillah'. As in Hisn al-Muslim, 'this night' then becomes 'this day'.
note.sw: Hadith inasema kwamba asubuhi Mtume alisema vivyo hivyo, akianza 'asbahna wa asbaha al-mulku lillah'. Kama ilivyo katika Hisn al-Muslim, 'usiku huu' hapo huwa 'siku hii'.

fadl_note.en: No particular reward is mentioned for it; it is what the Prophet said every morning and evening, and following his Sunnah is itself the virtue. In it you ask for the good of the day and seek refuge from laziness, the misery of old age, and the punishment of the Fire and the grave.
fadl_note.sw: Hakuna malipo maalumu yaliyotajwa kwa dua hii; ni dua aliyokuwa akiisema Mtume kila asubuhi na jioni, na kufuata Sunnah yake ndiyo fadhila yenyewe. Ndani yake unaomba kheri ya siku na kujikinga na uvivu, ubaya wa uzee, na adhabu ya Moto na ya kaburi.

title.en: By You we enter the morning

duas.ar: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
duas.tr: Allaahumma bika asbahnaa, wa bika amsaynaa, wa bika nahyaa, wa bika namuutu, wa ilaykan-nushuur.
duas.en: O Allah, by You we enter the morning and by You we enter the evening, by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the resurrection.
duas.sw: Ee Allah, kwa uwezo Wako tumeingia asubuhi na kwa uwezo Wako tumeingia jioni, kwa uwezo Wako tunaishi na kwa uwezo Wako tunakufa, na Kwako ndio kufufuliwa.

virtues.ar: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُعَلِّمُ أَصْحَابَهُ
virtues.en: The Messenger of Allah used to teach it to his companions, to say in the morning and the evening.
virtues.sw: Mtume wa Allah alikuwa akiwafundisha maswahaba wake waiseme asubuhi na jioni.

fadl_note.en: It reminds you that your life, your death and the resurrection are all by Allah.
fadl_note.sw: Inakukumbusha kwamba uhai wako, kifo chako na kufufuliwa vyote ni kwa Allah.

title.en: By You we enter the evening

duas.ar: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
duas.tr: Allaahumma bika amsaynaa, wa bika asbahnaa, wa bika nahyaa, wa bika namuutu, wa ilaykan-nushuur.
duas.en: O Allah, by You we enter the evening and by You we enter the morning, by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the resurrection.
duas.sw: Ee Allah, kwa uwezo Wako tumeingia jioni na kwa uwezo Wako tumeingia asubuhi, kwa uwezo Wako tunaishi na kwa uwezo Wako tunakufa, na Kwako ndio kufufuliwa.

virtues.ar: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُعَلِّمُ أَصْحَابَهُ
virtues.en: The Messenger of Allah used to teach it to his companions, to say in the morning and the evening.
virtues.sw: Mtume wa Allah alikuwa akiwafundisha maswahaba wake waiseme asubuhi na jioni.

fadl_note.en: It reminds you that your life, your death and the resurrection are all by Allah.
fadl_note.sw: Inakukumbusha kwamba uhai wako, kifo chako na kufufuliwa vyote ni kwa Allah.

duas.ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ لَكَ بِذَنْبِي، فَاغْفِرْ لِي، فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
duas.tr: Allaahumma Anta Rabbii, laa ilaaha illaa Ant, khalaqtanii wa ana 'abduk, wa ana 'alaa 'ahdika wa wa'dika mastata't, a'uudhu bika min sharri maa sana't, abuu'u laka bini'matika 'alayy, wa abuu'u laka bidhanbii, faghfir lii, fa innahu laa yaghfirudh-dhunuuba illaa Ant.
duas.en: O Allah, You are my Lord, there is none worthy of worship except You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I keep to Your covenant and promise as much as I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favour upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for none forgives sins except You.
duas.sw: Ee Allah, Wewe ni Mola wangu, hakuna mola apasaye kuabudiwa ila Wewe. Umeniumba nami ni mja Wako, nami niko juu ya agano Lako na ahadi Yako kadiri ninavyoweza. Najikinga Kwako dhidi ya shari ya nilichokifanya. Nakiri neema Yako juu yangu na nakiri dhambi yangu, basi nisamehe, kwani hakuna anayesamehe dhambi ila Wewe.

virtues.ar: سَيِّدُ الاِسْتِغْفَارِ
virtues.en: The Prophet called it the master (the best) of all supplications for forgiveness.
virtues.sw: Mtume aliiita bwana (bora) wa dua zote za kuomba msamaha.

virtues.ar: وَمَنْ قَالَهَا مِنَ النَّهَارِ مُوقِنًا بِهَا، فَمَاتَ مِنْ يَوْمِهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُمْسِيَ، فَهُوَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ
virtues.en: Whoever says it during the day with firm faith and dies that day before evening is among the people of Paradise; and likewise whoever says it at night and dies before morning.
virtues.sw: Atakayeisema mchana akiwa na yakini nayo, akafa siku hiyo kabla ya jioni, ni miongoni mwa watu wa Peponi; na vivyo hivyo atakayeisema usiku akafa kabla ya asubuhi.

duas.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي، وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، وَاحْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
duas.tr: Allaahumma innii as'alukal-'afwa wal-'aafiyata fid-dunyaa wal-aakhirah. Allaahumma innii as'alukal-'afwa wal-'aafiyata fii diinii wa dunyaaya wa ahlii wa maalii. Allaahummastur 'awraatii, wa aamin raw'aatii, wahfadhnii min bayni yadayya, wa min khalfii, wa 'an yamiinii, wa 'an shimaalii, wa min fawqii, wa a'uudhu bika an ughtaala min tahtii.
duas.en: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this world and the Hereafter. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religion, my worldly life, my family and my wealth. O Allah, cover my faults and calm my fears, and guard me from in front of me and behind me, from my right and my left, and from above me, and I seek refuge in You from being struck down from beneath me.
duas.sw: Ee Allah, nakuomba msamaha na afya katika dunia na Akhera. Ee Allah, nakuomba msamaha na afya katika dini yangu, dunia yangu, familia yangu na mali yangu. Ee Allah, sitiri aibu zangu na unitulize hofu zangu, na unihifadhi mbele yangu na nyuma yangu, kuliani kwangu na kushotoni kwangu, na juu yangu, na najikinga Kwako nisiangamizwe kutoka chini yangu.

virtues.ar: لَمْ يَكُنْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ يَدَعُ هَؤُلاَءِ الدَّعَوَاتِ حِينَ يُمْسِي وَحِينَ يُصْبِحُ
virtues.en: The Messenger of Allah never left these supplications in the evening and the morning.
virtues.sw: Mtume wa Allah hakuwahi kuziacha dua hizi jioni na asubuhi.

fadl_note.en: You ask Allah for pardon and well-being in your religion, your worldly life, your family and your wealth, and for protection from every side.
fadl_note.sw: Unamwomba Allah msamaha na afya katika dini yako, dunia yako, familia yako na mali yako, na ulinzi kutoka kila upande.

title.en: Knower of the unseen and the seen
title.sw: Mjuzi wa yaliyofichika na yaliyo wazi

duas.ar: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ، فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ
duas.tr: Allaahumma 'aalimal-ghaybi wash-shahaadah, faatiras-samaawaati wal-ard, rabba kulli shay'in wa maliikah, ash-hadu an laa ilaaha illaa Ant, a'uudhu bika min sharri nafsii, wa min sharrish-shaytaani wa shirkih.
duas.en: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Lord and Sovereign of all things, I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship except You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of my own self, and from the evil of Satan and his call to shirk.
duas.sw: Ee Allah, Mjuzi wa yaliyofichika na yaliyo wazi, Muumba wa mbingu na ardhi, Mola wa kila kitu na Mfalme wake, nashuhudia kwamba hakuna mola apasaye kuabudiwa ila Wewe. Najikinga Kwako dhidi ya shari ya nafsi yangu, na shari ya shetani na mwito wake wa ushirikina.

virtues.ar: قُلْهُ إِذَا أَصْبَحْتَ وَإِذَا أَمْسَيْتَ وَإِذَا أَخَذْتَ مَضْجَعَكَ
virtues.en: The Prophet told Abu Bakr: say it in the morning, in the evening and when you lie down to sleep.
virtues.sw: Mtume alimwambia Abu Bakr: iseme asubuhi, jioni na unapolala.

fadl_note.en: It seeks refuge from the evil of your own self and from Satan and his call to shirk.
fadl_note.sw: Ni kujikinga na shari ya nafsi yako na shetani na mwito wake wa ushirikina.

title.en: None worthy of worship but Allah alone
title.sw: Hakuna mola ila Allah peke Yake

duas.ar: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.tr: Laa ilaaha illallaahu wahdahu laa shariika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa Huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadiir.
duas.en: There is none worthy of worship except Allah alone, without partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He is able to do all things.
duas.sw: Hakuna mola apasaye kuabudiwa ila Allah peke Yake, hana mshirika. Ufalme ni Wake na sifa njema ni Zake, Naye ni Muweza wa kila kitu.

virtues.ar: كَانَ لَهُ عَدْلَ رَقَبَةٍ مِنْ وَلَدِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ وَحُطَّ عَنْهُ عَشْرُ خَطِيئَاتٍ وَرُفِعَ لَهُ عَشْرُ دَرَجَاتٍ وَكَانَ فِي حِرْزٍ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ حَتَّى يُمْسِيَ
virtues.en: Said in the morning: it is like freeing a slave from the descendants of Isma'il, ten sins are removed, he is raised ten degrees and he is protected from Satan until evening; and the same when said in the evening, until morning.
virtues.sw: Akisema asubuhi: ni kama kumwacha huru mtumwa wa kizazi cha Ismail, anafutiwa makosa kumi, anapandishwa daraja kumi na analindwa na shetani mpaka jioni; na vivyo hivyo akisema jioni, mpaka asubuhi.

title.en: None worthy of worship but Allah, 100 times a day
title.sw: Hakuna mola ila Allah, mara 100 kwa siku

duas.ar: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.tr: Laa ilaaha illallaahu wahdahu laa shariika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa Huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadiir.
duas.en: There is none worthy of worship except Allah alone, without partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He is able to do all things.
duas.sw: Hakuna mola apasaye kuabudiwa ila Allah peke Yake, hana mshirika. Ufalme ni Wake na sifa njema ni Zake, Naye ni Muweza wa kila kitu.

virtues.ar: كَانَتْ لَهُ عَدْلَ عَشْرِ رِقَابٍ، وَكُتِبَ لَهُ مِائَةُ حَسَنَةٍ، وَمُحِيَتْ عَنْهُ مِائَةُ سَيِّئَةٍ، وَكَانَتْ لَهُ حِرْزًا مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ يَوْمَهُ ذَلِكَ، حَتَّى يُمْسِيَ
virtues.en: Whoever says it a hundred times in a day: it equals freeing ten slaves, a hundred good deeds are written for him, a hundred bad deeds are erased, and it is a protection from Satan that day until evening.
virtues.sw: Atakayesema mara mia kwa siku: ni sawa na kuwaacha huru watumwa kumi, anaandikiwa mema mia, anafutiwa maovu mia, na ni kinga dhidi ya shetani siku hiyo mpaka jioni.

title.en: Glory to Allah, as many as His creation
title.sw: Utakatifu ni wa Allah, kwa idadi ya viumbe Vyake

duas.ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
duas.tr: Subhaanallaahi wa bihamdihi, 'adada khalqihi, wa ridaa nafsihi, wa zinata 'arshihi, wa midaada kalimaatih.
duas.en: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him, as many as the number of His creation, as much as pleases Him, as much as the weight of His Throne, and as much as the ink of His words.
duas.sw: Utakatifu ni wa Allah na sifa njema ni Zake, kwa idadi ya viumbe Vyake, kwa kiasi kinachomridhisha, kwa uzito wa Arshi Yake na kwa wingi wa wino wa maneno Yake.

note.en: The Prophet said these words three times after Fajr.
note.sw: Mtume alisema maneno haya mara tatu baada ya Alfajiri.

virtues.ar: لَوْ وُزِنَتْ بِمَا قُلْتِ مُنْذُ الْيَوْمِ لَوَزَنَتْهُنَّ
virtues.en: If they were weighed against everything you have said since the morning, they would outweigh it.
virtues.sw: Lau yangepimwa dhidi ya yote uliyoyasema tangu asubuhi, yangeyazidi uzito.

duas.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا، وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا، وَعَمَلاً مُتَقَبَّلاً
duas.tr: Allaahumma innii as'aluka 'ilman naafi'an, wa rizqan tayyiban, wa 'amalan mutaqabbalaa.
duas.en: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good provision and deeds that are accepted.
duas.sw: Ee Allah, nakuomba elimu yenye manufaa, riziki nzuri na amali zinazokubaliwa.

note.en: The Prophet said it after the Fajr prayer, when he finished with the salam.
note.sw: Mtume aliisema baada ya swala ya Alfajiri, alipotoa salamu.

fadl_note.en: No particular reward is mentioned for it; the Prophet said it after the Fajr prayer, asking for beneficial knowledge, good provision and accepted deeds.
fadl_note.sw: Hakuna malipo maalumu yaliyotajwa kwa dua hii; Mtume aliisema baada ya swala ya Alfajiri, akiomba elimu yenye manufaa, riziki nzuri na amali zinazokubaliwa.

title.en: Glory and praise to Allah, 100 times
title.sw: Utakatifu na sifa kwa Allah, mara 100

duas.ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
duas.tr: Subhaanallaahi wa bihamdih.
duas.en: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him.
duas.sw: Utakatifu ni wa Allah na sifa njema ni Zake.

virtues.ar: لَمْ يَأْتِ أَحَدٌ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ بِأَفْضَلَ مِمَّا جَاءَ بِهِ إِلاَّ أَحَدٌ قَالَ مِثْلَ مَا قَالَ أَوْ زَادَ عَلَيْهِ
virtues.en: Whoever says it a hundred times in the morning and the evening: no one will come on the Day of Resurrection with anything better, except someone who said the same or more.
virtues.sw: Atakayesema mara mia asubuhi na jioni: hakuna atakayekuja Siku ya Kiyama na bora kuliko alichokuja nacho, isipokuwa aliyesema kama yeye au zaidi.

virtues.ar: فِي يَوْمٍ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ حُطَّتْ خَطَايَاهُ، وَإِنْ كَانَتْ مِثْلَ زَبَدِ الْبَحْرِ
virtues.en: Whoever says it a hundred times in a day, his sins are wiped away even if they were like the foam of the sea.
virtues.sw: Atakayesema mara mia kwa siku, hufutiwa makosa yake hata kama yangekuwa mengi kama povu la bahari.

duas.ar: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
duas.tr: Astaghfirullaaha wa atuubu ilayh.
duas.en: I seek the forgiveness of Allah and I repent to Him.
duas.sw: Namwomba Allah msamaha na ninatubu Kwake.

virtues.ar: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ تُوبُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ فَإِنِّي أَتُوبُ فِي الْيَوْمِ إِلَيْهِ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ
virtues.en: O people, repent to Allah, for I repent to Him a hundred times a day.
virtues.sw: Enyi watu, tubuni kwa Allah, kwani mimi natubu Kwake mara mia kwa siku.

virtues.ar: وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ فِي الْيَوْمِ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ سَبْعِينَ مَرَّةً
virtues.en: By Allah, I seek Allah's forgiveness and repent to Him more than seventy times a day.
virtues.sw: Wallahi, hakika mimi namwomba Allah msamaha na kutubu Kwake zaidi ya mara sabini kwa siku.

body.en: Sit in a quiet place and make the intention to ask Allah for healing. Wudu is good but it is not a condition for ruqya. Recite calmly; you can follow along in a Mushaf to recite the verses correctly.
body.sw: Kaa mahali tulivu na weka nia ya kumuomba Allah uponyaji. Wudhu ni jambo jema lakini si sharti la ruqyah. Soma kwa utulivu; unaweza kutumia Msahafu kufuatilia aya kwa usahihi.

title.en: Blow into your hands and wipe

body.en: After reciting Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq and An-Nas, bring your palms together, blow lightly into them and wipe over your head, your face and the rest of your body that you can reach. Do this three times.
body.sw: Baada ya kusoma Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq na An-Naas, kusanya viganja, punguza pumzi kwa upole ndani yake na ujipanguse kichwani, usoni na sehemu nyingine za mwili unazoweza kufikia. Fanya hivyo mara tatu.

virtues.ar: كَانَ إِذَا أَوَى إِلَى فِرَاشِهِ كُلَّ لَيْلَةٍ جَمَعَ كَفَّيْهِ ثُمَّ نَفَثَ فِيهِمَا
virtues.en: This was the Prophet's practice every night when he went to bed.
virtues.sw: Hii ilikuwa desturi ya Mtume kila usiku alipokwenda kulala.

body.en: Sit beside the person, ask Allah for their healing and recite over them. You may place your right hand on them or on the place of pain, as the Prophet wiped over the sick with his right hand. Keep it gentle and respectful; a man should not touch a woman who is not his mahram.
body.sw: Kaa karibu na mtu huyo, mwombe Allah amponye, kisha umsomee. Unaweza kuweka mkono wako wa kulia juu yake au juu ya sehemu inayouma, kama Mtume alivyokuwa akiwapangusa wagonjwa kwa mkono wa kulia. Fanya kwa upole na heshima; mwanamume asimguse mwanamke asiye mahram wake.

subtitle.en: A self-ruqya for the evil eye from the Quran and Sunnah
subtitle.sw: Ruqyah sahihi ya kujisomea kwa kijicho

note.en: Using Al-Fatihah as ruqya is established in Sahih al-Bukhari 5736.
note.sw: Al-Fatiha kutumika kama ruqyah imethibiti katika Sahih al-Bukhari 5736.

note.en: The virtue of reciting it before sleep is narrated in Sahih al-Bukhari 2311.
note.sw: Fadhila ya kuisoma kabla ya kulala imesimuliwa katika Sahih al-Bukhari 2311.

note.en: They contain faith, a prayer for forgiveness and a plea for help. The virtue of reciting them at night is established in Sahih al-Bukhari 5009.
note.sw: Zina imani, dua ya msamaha, na maombi ya msaada. Fadhila ya kusoma aya mbili za mwisho za Suratul-Baqarah usiku imethibiti katika Sahih al-Bukhari 5009.

note.en: In brief: seeking refuge with the Lord of daybreak from the evil of creation, of darkness, of those who blow on knots, and of the envier when he envies.
note.sw: Maana kwa ufupi: Kuomba kinga kwa Mola wa mapambazuko dhidi ya shari ya viumbe, giza, wanaopulizia mafundo na mwenye husuda anapohusudu.

about.en: The evil eye is real, as the Prophet said, and it harms only by the permission of Allah. Symptoms alone do not prove it, so recite with trust in Allah and see a doctor as well.
about.sw: Kijicho kimethibiti kama alivyosema Mtume, na hakidhuru isipokuwa kwa idhini ya Allah. Dalili peke yake si uthibitisho, kwa hiyo jisomee ukimtegemea Allah na umwone daktari pia.

en: Sit somewhere quiet and make the intention to ask Allah for healing. Wudu is good but not required.
Read each step in order: Al-Fatihah, Ayat al-Kursi, the end of Al-Baqarah, then Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq and An-Nas.
Say the ruqya of Jibril and the supplication for healing, with your hand on the place of pain if there is one.
Finish by blowing lightly into your hands and wiping your head, face and body, three times.
Repeat it daily, or whenever you need, with patience. There is no fixed number of days.
sw: Kaa mahali tulivu na weka nia ya kumuomba Allah uponyaji. Wudhu ni jambo jema lakini si sharti.
Soma kila hatua kwa mpangilio: Al-Fatiha, Ayatul-Kursiy, mwisho wa Al-Baqarah, kisha Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq na An-Naas.
Soma ruqyah ya Jibril na dua ya kuomba uponyaji, ukiweka mkono juu ya sehemu inayouma kama ipo.
Maliza kwa kupuliza kwa upole viganjani na kujipangusa kichwani, usoni na mwilini, mara tatu.
Rudia kila siku, au kila unapohitaji, kwa subira. Hakuna idadi maalumu ya siku.

subtitle.en: Seeking refuge from the envier and healing from his harm
subtitle.sw: Kujikinga na mwenye husuda na kupona madhara yake

about.en: Envy (hasad) is wishing that a blessing be taken away from someone. Allah commands us to seek refuge from the envier, so this ruqya centres on Al-Falaq and the supplications that name the envier's eye. Envy and the evil eye are close: the same Quran and supplications protect from both.
about.sw: Husda ni kutamani neema iondoke kwa mwenzako. Allah ametuamrisha kujikinga na mwenye husuda, kwa hiyo ruqyah hii inajikita katika Suratul-Falaq na dua zinazotaja jicho la mwenye husuda. Husda na kijicho vinakaribiana: Qur'an na dua zilezile zinakinga dhidi ya vyote viwili.

en: Make the intention to seek refuge with Allah, not to find out who envied you.
Recite Al-Fatihah, Ayat al-Kursi and the three Quls. Pause on 'and from the evil of an envier when he envies' and mean it.
Say the ruqya of Jibril ('...or the eye of an envier') and the other supplications of protection.
Blow lightly into your hands and wipe over your head, face and body, three times.
Keep up the morning and evening adhkar every day: they are the daily shield against envy and the eye.
Do not accuse anyone. Return harm with good and make dua for them.
sw: Weka nia ya kujikinga kwa Allah, si kumtafuta aliyekuhusudu.
Soma Al-Fatiha, Ayatul-Kursiy na sura tatu za Qul. Simama kwenye 'na shari ya hasidi anapohusudu' na ukusudie maana yake.
Soma ruqyah ya Jibril ('...au jicho la mwenye husuda') na dua nyingine za kinga.
Pulizia kwa upole viganjani na ujipanguse kichwani, usoni na mwilini, mara tatu.
Endelea na adhkar za asubuhi na jioni kila siku: ndizo ngao ya kila siku dhidi ya husda na kijicho.
Usimtuhumu mtu. Lipa ubaya kwa wema na umwombee dua.

note.en: Its last verse, 'and from the evil of an envier when he envies', is refuge from envy itself.
note.sw: Aya yake ya mwisho, 'na shari ya hasidi anapohusudu', ni kujikinga na husda yenyewe.

note.en: It names the envier's eye: 'from the evil of every soul or the eye of an envier'. When reciting over yourself you may say 'Bismillaahi arqii nafsii' as your own supplication.
note.sw: Inataja jicho la mwenye husuda: 'dhidi ya shari ya kila nafsi au jicho la mwenye husuda'. Unapojisomea mwenyewe unaweza kusema 'Bismillaahi arqii nafsii' kama dua yako binafsi.

note.en: The Prophet used these words to seek protection for al-Hasan and al-Husayn from every harmful eye. They begin 'I seek refuge', so you can also say them for yourself.
note.sw: Mtume alitumia maneno haya kuwaombea kinga al-Hasan na al-Husayn dhidi ya kila jicho baya. Yanaanza 'Najikinga', kwa hiyo unaweza pia kuyasema kwa ajili yako mwenyewe.

subtitle.en: The verses scholars commonly recite for ruqya, then the Prophet's supplications
subtitle.sw: Aya ambazo wanachuoni husoma kwa ruqyah, kisha dua za Mtume

about.en: The complete ruqya gathers the verses scholars commonly recite for ruqya with the Prophet's supplications. It takes longer, so use it when you want a full session.
about.sw: Ruqyah kamili inakusanya aya ambazo wanachuoni husoma kwa ruqyah pamoja na dua za Mtume. Inachukua muda zaidi, kwa hiyo itumie unapotaka kikao kamili.

en: Prepare in a quiet place with the intention of asking Allah for healing.
Read the verses one after another, calmly. You can play the recitation and follow along.
Finish with the supplications, then blow into your hands and wipe your body three times.
You can repeat any verse as you need; no special number is required.
sw: Jitayarishe mahali tulivu ukiwa na nia ya kumuomba Allah uponyaji.
Soma aya moja baada ya nyingine kwa utulivu. Unaweza kucheza kisomo na kufuatilia.
Maliza kwa dua, kisha pulizia viganjani na ujipanguse mwilini mara tatu.
Unaweza kurudia aya yoyote kadiri unavyohitaji; hakuna idadi maalumu inayotakiwa.

subtitle.en: Verses about Musa and the magicians, and the falsehood of magic
subtitle.sw: Aya kuhusu Musa na wachawi, na ubatili wa uchawi

about.en: Magic (sihr) is real, but it harms no one except by Allah's permission, and its cure is with Allah. These verses tell how Allah made the magic of Pharaoh's magicians fail.
about.sw: Uchawi upo, lakini haumdhuru mtu isipokuwa kwa idhini ya Allah, na tiba yake iko kwa Allah. Aya hizi zinasimulia jinsi Allah alivyoubatilisha uchawi wa wachawi wa Firauni.

en: Never go to a magician or fortune teller to undo magic; that is forbidden.
Recite these verses with certainty that Allah makes falsehood fail.
Say the supplications, then blow into your hands and wipe your body three times.
Keep up the morning and evening adhkar and repeat the ruqya as needed, with patience.
sw: Kamwe usiende kwa mchawi au mtabiri kuondoa uchawi; hilo ni haramu.
Soma aya hizi ukiwa na yakini kwamba Allah huubatilisha upotofu.
Soma dua, kisha pulizia viganjani na ujipanguse mwilini mara tatu.
Endelea na adhkar za asubuhi na jioni na urudie ruqyah kadiri unavyohitaji, kwa subira.

subtitle.en: Seeking refuge from the devils and their whispering
subtitle.sw: Kujikinga na mashetani na wasiwasi wao

about.en: Allah gives refuge from the devils and their whispering. These verses and supplications are the protection the Quran and Sunnah teach.
about.sw: Allah anatoa kinga dhidi ya mashetani na wasiwasi wao. Aya na dua hizi ndizo kinga zinazofundishwa na Qur'an na Sunnah.

en: Recite calmly with a firm heart. Do not be afraid: Allah is the Protector.
Never ask jinn for help or follow anyone who claims to talk to them.
Finish with the perfect words of Allah, then wipe over your body.
Keep your prayers, the morning and evening adhkar and the verses before sleep.
sw: Soma kwa utulivu na moyo thabiti. Usiogope: Allah ndiye Mlinzi.
Kamwe usiombe msaada wa majini wala kumfuata anayedai kuzungumza nao.
Maliza kwa maneno kamili ya Allah, kisha ujipanguse mwilini.
Shikamana na swala zako, adhkar za asubuhi na jioni na aya za kabla ya kulala.

subtitle.en: The verses of healing and the Prophet's supplications for the sick
subtitle.sw: Aya za uponyaji na dua za Mtume kwa mgonjwa

about.en: Ruqya and medicine go together: recite over yourself and keep taking your treatment.
about.sw: Ruqyah na dawa huenda pamoja: jisomee na uendelee na matibabu yako.

en: Put your hand on the place of pain while you say the supplications for pain.
Recite Al-Fatihah and the verses of healing.
Ask Allah for healing with the Prophet's words.
Blow into your hands and wipe over the painful place and your body.
sw: Weka mkono wako juu ya sehemu inayouma unaposoma dua za maumivu.
Soma Al-Fatiha na aya za uponyaji.
Mwombe Allah uponyaji kwa maneno ya Mtume.
Pulizia viganjani na ujipanguse juu ya sehemu inayouma na mwilini.

subtitle.en: For a heavy heart: remembrance and the Prophet's supplications
subtitle.sw: Kwa moyo mzito: dhikri na dua za Mtume

about.en: When the heart is heavy, the Prophet turned to these supplications. In the remembrance of Allah hearts find rest.
about.sw: Moyo unapokuwa mzito, Mtume alikimbilia dua hizi. Kwa kumkumbuka Allah nyoyo hupata utulivu.

en: Read slowly and think about the meaning.
Say the supplications of distress and of Yunus with a present heart.
Recite Al-Fatihah, Ayat al-Kursi and the end of Al-Baqarah.
If the sadness lasts or is heavy, talk to someone you trust and see a doctor; that too is taking the means.
sw: Soma polepole na utafakari maana.
Soma dua za dhiki na dua ya Nabii Yunus kwa moyo uliohudhuria.
Soma Al-Fatiha, Ayatul-Kursiy na mwisho wa Al-Baqarah.
Huzuni ikiendelea au ikiwa nzito, zungumza na mtu unayemwamini na umwone daktari; hiyo pia ni kuchukua sababu.

title.en: For a child or family member

subtitle.en: Reciting over someone you care for

about.en: You can recite ruqya over your child or a family member, as the Prophet did for al-Hasan and al-Husayn and for his family.
about.sw: Unaweza kumsomea ruqyah mtoto wako au mwanafamilia, kama Mtume alivyowafanyia al-Hasan na al-Husayn na familia yake.

en: Sit beside them and make the intention to ask Allah for their healing.
Recite over them. You may put your right hand on them or on the place of pain.
Say the supplications for them, changing 'him' or 'her' as needed.
A man should not touch a woman who is not his mahram.
sw: Kaa karibu naye na weka nia ya kumuomba Allah amponye.
Msomee. Unaweza kuweka mkono wako wa kulia juu yake au juu ya sehemu inayouma.
Msomee dua, ukibadilisha 'yeye' (mwanamume au mwanamke) kama inavyohitajika.
Mwanamume asimguse mwanamke asiye mahram wake.

subtitle.en: After Fajr until the sun is high
subtitle.sw: Baada ya Alfajiri mpaka jua lipande

virtues.ar: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ وَالْمُعَوِّذَتَيْنِ حِينَ تُمْسِي وَحِينَ تُصْبِحُ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ تَكْفِيكَ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ
virtues.en: Recite Qul huwa Allahu ahad and the two Mu'awwidhat in the evening and the morning three times; they will suffice you against everything.
virtues.sw: Soma Qul huwa Allahu ahad na Al-Mu'awwidhatayn jioni na asubuhi mara tatu; zitakutosheleza dhidi ya kila kitu.

subtitle.en: Ayat al-Kursi, the end of Al-Baqarah and the three Quls
subtitle.sw: Ayatul-Kursiy, mwisho wa Al-Baqarah na sura tatu

en: Ruqya is reciting the Quran, the names and attributes of Allah, and the supplications taught by the Prophet (peace be upon him) over yourself or someone else, asking Allah for healing and protection.
The Prophet approved ruqya as long as it contains no shirk. When a companion recited Al-Fatihah over a man who had been stung and he recovered, the Prophet asked: 'How did you know it is a ruqya?'

Scholars name three conditions for ruqya to be lawful: it is with the words of Allah, His names and attributes, or authentic supplications; it is in Arabic or in words whose meaning is understood; and the one reciting believes it has no power by itself, because healing comes only from Allah by His decree.

Ruqya is worship and a means of asking Allah for healing. There is no promise of recovery within a fixed time. Keep making dua, be patient, and use the lawful means as well, including medical treatment.
sw: Ruqyah ya kisharia ni kusoma Qur'an, majina na sifa za Allah, na dua alizofundisha Mtume (rehema na amani ziwe juu yake) juu yako mwenyewe au juu ya mtu mwingine, ukimwomba Allah uponyaji na kinga.
Mtume aliruhusu ruqyah ilimradi haina shirki. Swahaba alipomsomea Al-Fatiha mtu aliyeumwa (na mdudu) akapona, Mtume aliuliza: 'Umejuaje kwamba ni ruqyah?'

Wanachuoni wametaja masharti matatu ili ruqyah iwe halali: iwe kwa maneno ya Allah, majina na sifa Zake, au dua sahihi; iwe kwa Kiarabu au kwa maneno yanayoeleweka maana yake; na msomaji aamini kwamba haina nguvu yenyewe, kwa sababu uponyaji unatoka kwa Allah peke yake kwa kudura Yake.
Ruqyah ni ibada na sababu ya kuomba uponyaji; hakuna ahadi ya kupona ndani ya muda maalumu. Endelea kuomba dua, kuwa na subira, na tumia pia sababu halali, ikiwemo matibabu ya hospitali.

evidence.ar: اعْرِضُوا عَلَيَّ رُقَاكُمْ لاَ بَأْسَ بِالرُّقَى مَا لَمْ يَكُنْ فِيهِ شِرْكٌ
evidence.en: Show me your ruqyas. There is no harm in ruqya as long as it contains no shirk.
evidence.sw: Nionyesheni ruqyah zenu. Hakuna ubaya katika ruqyah ilimradi haina shirki.

evidence.ar: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ أَنَّهَا رُقْيَةٌ
evidence.en: And how did you know it is a ruqya?
evidence.sw: Na umejuaje kwamba hiyo ni ruqyah?

title.en: How to recite ruqya over yourself

en: You can recite ruqya over yourself. You do not need a special raqi, and nobody needs to be paid.
Sit in a calm place with the intention of asking Allah for healing. Wudu is good but it is not a condition. Recite clearly, think about the meaning and turn your heart to Allah.
As the Prophet did, you may recite into your cupped hands, blow lightly and wipe over your head, your face and as much of your body as you can reach.
For pain, put your hand on the place that hurts, say 'Bismillah' three times, then say seven times: 'A'uudhu billaahi wa qudratihi min sharri maa ajidu wa uhaadhir'.
Repeat what you need. Fixed numbers such as 41, 313 or 1,000 repetitions have no proof in the Sunnah; keep only the numbers the hadith itself mentions.
Keep up your daily protection: the morning and evening remembrance and the verses before sleep.
sw: Unaweza kujisomea ruqyah mwenyewe. Huhitaji msomaji maalumu, na hakuna anayehitaji kulipwa.
Kaa mahali tulivu ukiwa na nia ya kumuomba Allah uponyaji. Wudhu ni jambo jema lakini si sharti. Soma kwa uwazi, tafakari maana na uelekeze moyo wako kwa Allah.
Kama alivyofanya Mtume, unaweza kusoma ndani ya viganja vyako, kupuliza kwa upole na kujipangusa kichwani, usoni na sehemu ya mwili unayoweza kufikia.
Kwa maumivu, weka mkono wako juu ya sehemu inayouma, sema 'Bismillah' mara tatu, kisha sema mara saba: 'A'uudhu billaahi wa qudratihi min sharri maa ajidu wa uhaadhir'.
Rudia kadiri unavyohitaji. Idadi maalumu kama 41, 313 au 1,000 hazina ushahidi katika Sunnah; shika idadi zilizotajwa na hadith yenyewe tu.
Endelea na kinga yako ya kila siku: adhkar za asubuhi na jioni na aya za kabla ya kulala.

evidence.ar: كَانَ إِذَا أَوَى إِلَى فِرَاشِهِ كُلَّ لَيْلَةٍ جَمَعَ كَفَّيْهِ ثُمَّ نَفَثَ فِيهِمَا
evidence.en: When he went to bed each night, he would bring his palms together and blow into them (and recite Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq and An-Nas, then wipe over his body three times).
evidence.sw: Alipokwenda kulala kila usiku, alikusanya viganja vyake na kupuliza ndani yake (na kusoma Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq na An-Naas, kisha kujipangusa mwilini mara tatu).

evidence.ar: كَانَ إِذَا اشْتَكَى يَقْرَأُ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِالْمُعَوِّذَاتِ وَيَنْفُثُ
evidence.en: When he was ill, he would recite the Mu'awwidhat over himself and blow.
evidence.sw: Alipokuwa mgonjwa, alikuwa akijisomea Al-Mu'awwidhat na kupuliza.

evidence.ar: ضَعْ يَدَكَ عَلَى الَّذِي تَأَلَّمَ مِنْ جَسَدِكَ وَقُلْ بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ
evidence.en: Put your hand on the part of your body that hurts and say: Bismillah (three times), and say seven times: A'uudhu billaahi wa qudratihi min sharri maa ajidu wa uhaadhir.
evidence.sw: Weka mkono wako juu ya sehemu ya mwili wako inayouma na useme: Bismillah (mara tatu), na useme mara saba: A'uudhu billaahi wa qudratihi min sharri maa ajidu wa uhaadhir.

en: The evil eye is real, as the Prophet said. It comes from admiration or envy, and it harms only by the permission of Allah.
When you see something you like in someone else, in your child or in yourself, ask Allah to bless it, for example 'Baarakallaahu fiik' or 'Allaahumma baarik'.
If the person whose eye caused the harm is known, they may be asked to wash, and the water is poured over the one affected. The Prophet said: 'If you are asked to wash, then wash.'
Do not accuse anyone of giving the evil eye without clear evidence.
Symptoms such as vomiting, yawning, feeling hot or certain dreams do not prove the evil eye. Recite the ruqya, keep your morning and evening remembrance, and see a doctor too.
sw: Kijicho kimethibiti, kama alivyosema Mtume. Hutokana na kustaajabia au husuda, na hakidhuru isipokuwa kwa idhini ya Allah.
Unapoona kitu kinachokupendeza kwa mtu mwingine, kwa mtoto wako au kwako mwenyewe, mwombe Allah akibariki, kwa mfano 'Baarakallaahu fiik' au 'Allaahumma baarik'.
Ikiwa mtu aliyesababisha kijicho anajulikana, anaweza kuombwa aoge (atawadhe), na maji hayo yamwagiwe aliyeathirika. Mtume alisema: 'Mkiombwa kuoga, basi ogeni.'
Usimtuhumu mtu kwa kijicho bila ushahidi.
Kutapika, kupiga miayo, kuhisi joto au kuota ndoto fulani si uthibitisho wa kijicho. Jisomee ruqyah, endelea na adhkar za asubuhi na jioni, na umwone daktari pia.

evidence.ar: الْعَيْنُ حَقٌّ
evidence.en: The evil eye is real.
evidence.sw: Kijicho ni kweli.

evidence.ar: الْعَيْنُ حَقٌّ وَلَوْ كَانَ شَيْءٌ سَابَقَ الْقَدَرَ سَبَقَتْهُ الْعَيْنُ وَإِذَا اسْتُغْسِلْتُمْ فَاغْسِلُوا
evidence.en: The evil eye is real. If anything were to overtake destiny, the evil eye would. And when you are asked to wash, then wash.
evidence.sw: Kijicho ni kweli. Lau kingekuwepo kitu kinachotangulia kudura, kijicho kingeitangulia. Na mkiombwa kuoga, basi ogeni.

evidence.ar: إِذَا رَأَى أَحَدُكُمْ مِنْ أَخِيهِ مَا يُعْجِبُهُ فَلْيَدْعُ لَهُ بِالْبَرَكَةِ
evidence.en: When one of you sees something in his brother that pleases him, let him pray for blessing for him.
evidence.sw: Mmoja wenu akiona kwa ndugu yake kitu kinachompendeza, amwombee baraka.

evidence.ar: كَانَ يُؤْمَرُ الْعَائِنُ فَيَتَوَضَّأُ ثُمَّ يَغْتَسِلُ مِنْهُ الْمَعِينُ
evidence.en: The one who gave the evil eye would be told to perform wudu, then the one affected would wash with that water.
evidence.sw: Aliyetoa kijicho aliamrishwa kutawadha, kisha aliyeathirika huoga kwa maji hayo.

en: Envy (hasad) is disliking a blessing Allah has given someone and wishing it would be taken from them. It is a sin of the heart, and the Prophet said: 'Do not envy one another.'

Envy and the evil eye are close but not the same. The evil eye is harm that comes through a look, from envy or even from admiration; envy can be in the heart without a look. Allah teaches us to seek refuge from both: Al-Falaq ends with 'and from the evil of an envier when he envies', and the ruqya of Jibril names 'the eye of an envier'. So the same Quran and supplications protect from both.

How to protect yourself: keep the morning and evening adhkar, recite Al-Falaq and An-Nas, rely on Allah and do not live in fear of people, for nothing harms except by Allah's permission. Ya'qub told Yusuf not to tell his dream to his brothers, so it is wise not to display your blessings before those you fear may envy.

If you think envy has harmed you: recite the ruqya, ask Allah for healing, be patient, and do not accuse anyone without clear evidence. Return harm with good and make dua for them; repentance and charity are also good means.

If you find envy in your own heart: ask Allah to bless what you admire ('Allahumma barik'), love for your brother what you love for yourself, and ask Allah for His bounty instead of wishing it away from others. Wanting good like someone else has without wishing it removed from them is allowed: the Prophet said there is no envy except in two cases, a man Allah gave wealth who spends it in the right way, and a man Allah gave wisdom who judges by it and teaches it.
sw: Husda ni kuchukia neema aliyompa Allah mtu na kutamani iondoke kwake. Ni dhambi ya moyo, na Mtume alisema: 'Msihusudiane.'

Husda na kijicho vinakaribiana lakini si kitu kimoja. Kijicho ni madhara yanayokuja kupitia mtazamo, kutokana na husda au hata kustaajabia; husda inaweza kuwa moyoni bila mtazamo. Allah ametufundisha kujikinga na vyote viwili: Suratul-Falaq inamalizika kwa 'na shari ya hasidi anapohusudu', na ruqyah ya Jibril inataja 'jicho la mwenye husuda'. Kwa hiyo Qur'an na dua zilezile zinakinga dhidi ya vyote viwili.

Jinsi ya kujikinga: shikamana na adhkar za asubuhi na jioni, soma Al-Falaq na An-Naas, mtegemee Allah na usiishi kwa kuwaogopa watu, kwani hakuna kinachodhuru isipokuwa kwa idhini ya Allah. Ya'qub alimwambia Yusuf asiwasimulie nduguze ndoto yake, kwa hiyo ni busara kutoonyesha neema zako mbele ya wale unaohofia watakuhusudu.
Ukidhani umedhurika na husda: jisomee ruqyah, mwombe Allah uponyaji, kuwa na subira, na usimtuhumu mtu bila ushahidi wa wazi. Lipa ubaya kwa wema na uwaombee dua; toba na sadaka pia ni sababu nzuri.

Ukiona husda moyoni mwako: mwombe Allah abariki unachostaajabia ('Allahumma barik'), mpendee nduguyo unachokipenda nafsi yako, na mwombe Allah fadhila Zake badala ya kutamani ziondoke kwa wengine. Kutamani kheri kama aliyonayo mwingine bila kutaka iondoke kwake kunaruhusiwa: Mtume alisema hakuna husda isipokuwa katika mambo mawili, mtu aliyepewa na Allah mali akaitumia katika haki, na mtu aliyepewa na Allah hekima akahukumu kwayo na kuifundisha.

evidence.ar: مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ نَفْسٍ أَوْ عَيْنِ حَاسِدٍ
evidence.en: From the evil of every soul or the eye of an envier. (The ruqya of Jibril)
evidence.sw: Dhidi ya shari ya kila nafsi au jicho la mwenye husuda. (Ruqyah ya Jibril)

evidence.ar: وَلاَ تَحَاسَدُوا، وَلاَ تَدَابَرُوا، وَلاَ تَبَاغَضُوا، وَكُونُوا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ إِخْوَانًا
evidence.en: Do not envy one another, do not turn away from one another, do not hate one another, and be, O servants of Allah, brothers.
evidence.sw: Msihusudiane, msipeane migongo, msichukiane, na kuweni, enyi waja wa Allah, ndugu.

evidence.ar: دَبَّ إِلَيْكُمْ دَاءُ الأُمَمِ قَبْلَكُمُ الْحَسَدُ وَالْبَغْضَاءُ
evidence.en: The disease of the nations before you has crept into you: envy and hatred.
evidence.sw: Umewanyemelea ugonjwa wa umma zilizokutangulieni: husda na chuki.

evidence.ar: لا يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ
evidence.en: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
evidence.sw: Hatoamini kikamilifu mmoja wenu mpaka ampendee nduguye anachokipenda nafsi yake.

evidence.ar: إِذَا رَأَى أَحَدُكُمْ مِنْ أَخِيهِ مَا يُعْجِبُهُ فَلْيَدْعُ لَهُ بِالْبَرَكَةِ
evidence.en: When one of you sees something in his brother that pleases him, let him pray for blessing for him.
evidence.sw: Mmoja wenu akiona kwa nduguye kitu kinachompendeza, amwombee baraka.

evidence.ar: لاَ حَسَدَ إِلاَّ فِي اثْنَتَيْنِ رَجُلٌ آتَاهُ اللَّهُ مَالاً فَسُلِّطَ عَلَى هَلَكَتِهِ فِي الْحَقِّ، وَرَجُلٌ آتَاهُ اللَّهُ الْحِكْمَةَ، فَهْوَ يَقْضِي بِهَا وَيُعَلِّمُهَا
evidence.en: There is no envy except in two: a man whom Allah gave wealth and he spends it in the right way, and a man whom Allah gave wisdom and he judges by it and teaches it.
evidence.sw: Hakuna husda isipokuwa katika mambo mawili: mtu aliyepewa na Allah mali akaitumia katika haki, na mtu aliyepewa na Allah hekima akahukumu kwayo na kuifundisha.

en: Amulets, charms, threads and written papers hung for protection. The Prophet called such charms shirk. Many scholars also advised against amulets with Quran written on them, to close the door to relying on objects.
Fortune tellers, sorcerers and anyone who claims to know the unseen, asks for your mother's name, or asks for a sacrifice to anyone other than Allah.
Seeking help from jinn, and 'ruqya' with words, symbols, numbers or names whose meaning is not understood.
Anyone who demands large payments, isolates you, touches you in an improper way, or tells you to stop your medicine.
sw: Hirizi, talasimu, nyuzi na karatasi zilizoandikwa zinazotundikwa kwa ajili ya kinga. Mtume aliita hirizi hizo shirki. Wanachuoni wengi pia walishauri kuepuka hirizi zilizoandikwa Qur'an, ili kufunga mlango wa kutegemea vitu.
Watabiri, wachawi na yeyote anayedai kujua mambo ya ghaibu, anayeuliza jina la mama yako, au anayeomba kafara kwa asiyekuwa Allah.
Kuomba msaada wa majini, na 'ruqyah' yenye maneno, alama, namba au majina yasiyoeleweka maana yake.
Yeyote anayedai malipo makubwa, anayekutenga na watu, anayekugusa isivyofaa, au anayekuambia uache dawa zako.

evidence.ar: إِنَّ الرُّقَى وَالتَّمَائِمَ وَالتِّوَلَةَ شِرْكٌ
evidence.en: Incantations, amulets and love-charms are shirk. (The incantations meant here are those containing shirk, as the next hadith shows.)
evidence.sw: Ruqyah (za kishirikina), hirizi na dawa za mapenzi ni shirki. (Ruqyah zinazokusudiwa hapa ni zile zenye shirki, kama inavyoonyesha hadith inayofuata.)

evidence.ar: لاَ بَأْسَ بِالرُّقَى مَا لَمْ يَكُنْ فِيهِ شِرْكٌ
evidence.en: There is no harm in ruqya as long as it contains no shirk.
evidence.sw: Hakuna ubaya katika ruqyah ilimradi haina shirki.

evidence.ar: مَنْ أَتَى عَرَّافًا فَسَأَلَهُ عَنْ شَيْءٍ لَمْ تُقْبَلْ لَهُ صَلاَةٌ أَرْبَعِينَ لَيْلَةً
evidence.en: Whoever goes to a fortune teller and asks him about anything, his prayer will not be accepted for forty nights.
evidence.sw: Atakayemwendea mtabiri na kumuuliza kuhusu jambo lolote, swala yake haitakubaliwa kwa siku arobaini.

en: Islam tells us to seek treatment. Ruqya and medicine go together; one does not cancel the other.
Do not stop hospital treatment or prescribed medicine because of ruqya. Illnesses of the mind are illnesses like any other and deserve proper care.
The Prophet also spoke about remedies such as honey and black seed.
If symptoms continue or are severe, get a medical assessment as well.
sw: Uislamu unatuamrisha kutafuta matibabu. Ruqyah na dawa huenda pamoja; kimoja hakifuti kingine.
Usiache matibabu ya hospitali au dawa ulizoandikiwa kwa sababu ya ruqyah. Maradhi ya akili ni maradhi kama mengine na yanastahili matibabu sahihi.
Mtume pia alizungumzia tiba kama asali na habbat sawdaa (mbegu nyeusi).
Ikiwa dalili zinaendelea au ni kali, tafuta tathmini ya kitabibu pia.

evidence.ar: تَدَاوَوْا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ لَمْ يَضَعْ دَاءً إِلاَّ وَضَعَ لَهُ دَوَاءً غَيْرَ دَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ الْهَرَمُ
evidence.en: Seek treatment, for Allah has not created a disease without creating a cure for it, except one disease: old age.
evidence.sw: Tafuteni matibabu, kwani Allah hakuweka ugonjwa wowote isipokuwa ameweka dawa yake, isipokuwa ugonjwa mmoja: uzee.

evidence.ar: اسْقِهِ عَسَلاً
evidence.en: Give him honey to drink.
evidence.sw: Mnyweshe asali.

evidence.ar: فِي الْحَبَّةِ السَّوْدَاءِ شِفَاءٌ مِنْ كُلِّ دَاءٍ إِلاَّ السَّامَ
evidence.en: In the black seed there is healing for every disease except death.
evidence.sw: Katika habbat sawdaa kuna ponyo la kila ugonjwa isipokuwa kifo.

en: Reciting the Quran and the established supplications is lawful ruqya.
There is not enough evidence to make 41, 313 or 1,000 repetitions a special Sunnah for the evil eye.
Vomiting, yawning, feeling hot or certain dreams are not proof of the evil eye.
Do not accuse anyone of the evil eye without evidence.
Avoid amulets, talismans, asking jinn for help, and words that are not understood.
Do not abandon hospital treatment because of ruqya.

The often-quoted words 'Beware of envy, for envy eats good deeds as fire eats wood' are graded weak (Abu Dawud 4903, al-Albani). Envy is still forbidden by authentic hadith such as 'Do not envy one another'.

Ruqya is worship and a means of asking for healing; there is no promise of recovery within a fixed time. If symptoms continue or are severe, seek a medical assessment as well. May Allah grant you health and healing.
sw: Kusoma Qur'an na dua zilizothibiti ni ruqyah ya kisharia.
Hakuna ushahidi wa kutosha wa kuifanya idadi ya 41, 313 au 1,000 kuwa Sunnah maalumu ya kijicho.
Kutapika, kupiga miayo, kuhisi joto au kuota ndoto fulani si uthibitisho wa kijicho.
Usimtuhumu mtu kwa kijicho bila ushahidi.
Epuka hirizi, talasimu, kuomba msaada wa majini na maneno yasiyoeleweka.
Usiache matibabu ya hospitali kwa sababu ya ruqyah.

Maneno yanayonukuliwa sana 'Jihadharini na husda, kwani husda hula mema kama moto unavyokula kuni' yamepewa daraja la dhaifu (Abu Dawud 4903, al-Albani). Husda bado ni haramu kwa hadith sahihi kama 'Msihusudiane'.
Ruqyah ni ibada na sababu ya kuomba uponyaji; hakuna ahadi ya kupona ndani ya muda maalumu. Ikiwa dalili zinaendelea au ni kali, tafuta tathmini ya kitabibu pia. Allah akupe afya na uponyaji.

en: The Prophet described seventy thousand of his nation who will enter Paradise without reckoning: those who do not ask others for ruqya, do not take bad omens, do not seek cauterisation, and rely upon their Lord.

This praises complete reliance on Allah. Scholars explained that reciting over yourself and your family does not go against it: the Prophet recited over himself, and reciting for others is a kindness. Asking someone for ruqya also remains permissible.
Whatever you do, let your heart rely on Allah alone. The words are a means; the Healer is Allah.
sw: Mtume aliwaeleza watu elfu sabini wa umma wake watakaoingia Peponi bila hesabu: wale wasioomba wengine wawasomee ruqyah, wasiotabiri mikosi, wasiotaka kuchomwa (kwa moto kama tiba), na wanaomtegemea Mola wao.

Hii ni sifa ya kumtegemea Allah kikamilifu. Wanachuoni walieleza kwamba kujisomea mwenyewe na kuisomea familia yako hakupingani na hilo: Mtume alijisomea mwenyewe, na kumsomea mwingine ni wema. Kumwomba mtu akusomee ruqyah pia kunabaki kuwa halali.
Chochote utakachofanya, moyo wako umtegemee Allah peke yake. Maneno ni sababu tu; Mponyaji ni Allah.

evidence.ar: هُمُ الَّذِينَ لاَ يَسْتَرْقُونَ، وَلاَ يَتَطَيَّرُونَ، وَلاَ يَكْتَوُونَ وَعَلَى رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ
evidence.en: They are those who do not ask for ruqya, do not take bad omens, do not seek cauterisation, and rely upon their Lord.
evidence.sw: Wao ni wale wasioomba kusomewa ruqyah, wasiotabiri mikosi, wasiotaka kuchomwa, na wanaomtegemea Mola wao.

evidence.ar: كَانَ إِذَا اشْتَكَى يَقْرَأُ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِالْمُعَوِّذَاتِ وَيَنْفُثُ
evidence.en: When he was ill, he would recite the Mu'awwidhat over himself and blow.
evidence.sw: Alipokuwa mgonjwa, alikuwa akijisomea Al-Mu'awwidhat na kupuliza.

en: The Prophet said: 'Allah has ninety-nine names, one hundred less one; whoever learns them (ahsaha) will enter Paradise.' Learning them means knowing their words and meanings, and worshipping Allah by them, including calling upon Him with them.

The well-known list of 99 names that is widely memorised comes from a narration in at-Tirmidhi whose list of names is not authentic from the Prophet; hadith scholars said the list was added by a narrator. Allah's names are also more than ninety-nine.

So the names here are the ones Shaykh Muhammad ibn Salih al-Uthaymeen gathered in al-Qawa'id al-Muthla from the Quran and the authentic Sunnah: 81 from the Quran and 18 from the Sunnah, each shown with where it comes from.
sw: Mtume alisema: 'Allah ana majina tisini na tisa, mia moja kasoro moja; atakayeyahifadhi (ahsaha) ataingia Peponi.' Kuyahifadhi ni kujua matamshi na maana zake, na kumwabudu Allah kwayo, ikiwemo kumwomba kwa majina hayo.

Orodha maarufu ya majina 99 inayohifadhiwa na wengi inatokana na riwaya ya at-Tirmidhi ambayo orodha yake ya majina haikuthibiti kutoka kwa Mtume; wanachuoni wa hadith walisema orodha hiyo iliongezwa na msimulizi. Majina ya Allah pia ni zaidi ya tisini na tisa.

Kwa hiyo majina yaliyo hapa ni yale aliyoyakusanya Sheikh Muhammad ibn Salih al-Uthaymeen katika kitabu al-Qawa'id al-Muthla kutoka katika Qur'an na Sunnah sahihi: 81 kutoka katika Qur'an na 18 kutoka katika Sunnah, kila moja likionyeshwa limetoka wapi.

intro_evidence.ar: إِنَّ لِلَّهِ تِسْعَةً وَتِسْعِينَ اسْمًا، مِائَةً إِلاَّ وَاحِدًا، مَنْ أَحْصَاهَا دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ
intro_evidence.en: Allah has ninety-nine names, one hundred less one; whoever learns them will enter Paradise.
intro_evidence.sw: Allah ana majina tisini na tisa, mia moja kasoro moja; atakayeyahifadhi ataingia Peponi.

names.en: Allah: the one true God, who alone deserves worship
names.sw: Allah: Mungu wa haki, peke Yake ndiye anayestahiki kuabudiwa

names.en: The One, unique with no equal
names.sw: Mmoja wa pekee, asiye na mfano

names.en: The First: there is nothing before Him
names.sw: Wa Kwanza: hakuna kitu kabla Yake

names.en: The Last: there is nothing after Him
names.sw: Wa Mwisho: hakuna kitu baada Yake

names.en: The Most High over all: there is nothing above Him
names.sw: Aliye juu ya kila kitu: hakuna kitu juu Yake

names.en: The Nearest, the Hidden: nothing is beyond Him
names.sw: Aliye karibu, Aliyefichika: hakuna kitu kilicho mbali Naye

names.en: The Maker, who brings creation into being
The One who accepts repentance, again and again
names.sw: Mpokeaji wa toba, tena na tena

names.en: The Compeller, who also mends what is broken
names.sw: Mwenye nguvu za kulazimisha, Anayeunga kilichovunjika

names.en: The Reckoner, the One who is sufficient

names.sw: Mwenye huruma na wema mwingi kwa mja Wake

note.en: Ibn Uthaymeen said he hesitated over including this name, because it comes only in a restricted phrase: Ibrahim's words 'He has been ever gracious to me'.
note.sw: Ibn Uthaymeen alisema alisita kuliweka jina hili, kwa sababu limekuja kwa kufungamana tu: maneno ya Ibrahim 'Hakika Yeye amekuwa mwema sana kwangu'.

names.en: The Clear, who makes the truth clear
The Forbearing, who does not hasten punishment

names.sw: Msimamizi wa kila kitu, asiyehitaji chochote

names.en: The Creator of all things, again and again
The Perfect, free of every flaw, the Source of peace
names.sw: Aliye salama na kila kasoro, Mtoaji wa amani

names.en: The Most Appreciative, who rewards much for little
names.sw: Mwingi wa kushukuru, Anayelipa kingi kwa kidogo

names.en: The Self-Sufficient, whom all creation turns to in need
names.sw: Anayekusudiwa na viumbe vyote kwa haja zao

names.en: The Knower of the unseen and the seen
names.sw: Mjuzi wa yaliyofichika na yaliyo wazi

names.en: The Pardoner, who wipes sins away
The Rich, free of all need
The Judge, the Opener of all good
names.sw: Mwenye kuhukumu kwa haki, Mfunguaji wa kheri
Mshindi aliye juu ya waja Wake
Mwenye uweza juu ya kila kitu

names.en: The Subtly Kind, who knows the finest details
names.sw: Mpole, Mjuzi wa mambo madogo yaliyofichika

names.en: The Giver of security, who affirms the truth
The All-Encompassing in knowledge and power
names.sw: Mwenye kuzunguka kila kitu kwa ujuzi na uweza

names.en: The Nourisher, who keeps watch over all things
The Guardian over all, the Overseer
names.sw: Mwenye kusimamia na kushuhudia kila kitu

names.en: The Inheritor, who remains after all
The Vast in bounty and knowledge
names.sw: Mwenye wasaa wa fadhila na ujuzi

names.en: The Trustee, on whom all rely

note.en: Ibn Uthaymeen cites it from Ahmad, at-Tirmidhi (who graded it hasan) and al-Bayhaqi. Al-Albani graded at-Tirmidhi's chain weak.
note.sw: Ibn Uthaymeen ameitaja kutoka kwa Ahmad, at-Tirmidhi (aliyeipa daraja ya hasan) na al-Bayhaqi. Al-Albani aliipa njia ya at-Tirmidhi daraja ya dhaifu.

names.en: The Modest, too generous to turn away empty the hands raised to Him
names.sw: Mwenye haya, hairudishi mikono mitupu iliyonyooshwa Kwake

names.en: The Lord, Creator, Owner and Sustainer
The Glorified, free of every imperfection

cite.en: At-Tabarani, al-Mu'jam al-Awsat (al-Haythami: its narrators are trustworthy)
cite.sw: At-Tabarani, al-Mu'jam al-Awsat (al-Haythami: wasimulizi wake ni waaminifu)

note.en: Ibn Uthaymeen said he hesitated over this name because he had not examined its narrators in at-Tabarani; Shaykh al-Islam Ibn Taymiyyah counted it among the names.
note.sw: Ibn Uthaymeen alisema alisita kuhusu jina hili kwa sababu hakuwachunguza wasimulizi wake katika at-Tabarani; Sheikh al-Islam Ibn Taymiyyah alilihesabu miongoni mwa majina.

names.en: The One, the Single, who loves what is odd

1:1.en: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
1:1.sw: KWA JINA LA MWENYEZI MUNGU MWINGI WA REHEMA MWENYE KUREHEMU.

1:2.en: [All] praise is [due] to Allah, Lord of the worlds -
1:2.sw: Sifa njema zote ni za Mwenyezi Mungu, Mola Mlezi wa viumbe vyote;

1:3.en: The Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful,

1:4.en: Sovereign of the Day of Recompense.

1:5.en: It is You we worship and You we ask for help.
1:5.sw: Wewe tu tunakuabudu, na Wewe tu tunakuomba msaada.

1:6.en: Guide us to the straight path -

1:7.h: صِرَٰطَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ غَيۡرِ ٱلۡمَغۡضُوبِ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا ٱلضَّآلِّينَ ٧
1:7.t: صِرَٰطَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
1:7.tr: Sirata allatheena an'amta 'alayhim ghayri almaghdoobi 'alayhim wala addalleen
1:7.en: The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, not of those who have evoked [Your] anger or of those who are astray.
1:7.sw: Njia ya ulio waneemesha, siyo ya walio kasirikiwa, wala walio potea.

2:2.h: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبُ لَا رَيۡبَۛ فِيهِۛ هُدٗى لِّلۡمُتَّقِينَ ٢
2:2.t: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبُ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ هُدًى لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
2:2.tr: Thalika alkitabu la rayba feehi hudan lilmuttaqeen
2:2.en: This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah -
2:2.sw: Hiki ni Kitabu kisichokuwa na shaka ndani yake; ni uwongofu kwa wachamungu,

2:3.h: ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَيُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقۡنَٰهُمۡ يُنفِقُونَ ٣
2:3.t: ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَيُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ
2:3.tr: Allatheena yuminoona bilghaybi wayuqeemoona assalata wamimma razaqnahum yunfiqoon
2:3.en: Who believe in the unseen, establish prayer, and spend out of what We have provided for them,
2:3.sw: Ambao huyaamini ya ghaibu na hushika Sala, na hutoa katika tuliyo wapa.

2:4.h: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيۡكَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ مِن قَبۡلِكَ وَبِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ هُمۡ يُوقِنُونَ ٤
2:4.t: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ مِن قَبْلِكَ وَبِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ
2:4.tr: Wallatheena yuminoona bima onzila ilayka wama onzila min qablika wabilakhirati hum yooqinoon
2:4.en: And who believe in what has been revealed to you, [O Muhammad], and what was revealed before you, and of the Hereafter they are certain [in faith].
2:4.sw: Na ambao wanayaamini yaliyo teremshwa kwako, na yaliyo teremshwa kabla yako; na Akhera wana yakini nayo.

2:5.h: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدٗى مِّن رَّبِّهِمۡۖ وَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡمُفۡلِحُونَ ٥
2:5.t: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدًى مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
2:5.tr: Olaika 'ala hudan min rabbihim waolaika humu almuflihoon
2:5.en: Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful.
2:5.sw: Hao wapo juu ya uwongofu utokao kwa Mola wao Mlezi, na hao ndio walio fanikiwa.

2:102.h: وَٱتَّبَعُواْ مَا تَتۡلُواْ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ عَلَىٰ مُلۡكِ سُلَيۡمَٰنَۖ وَمَا كَفَرَ سُلَيۡمَٰنُ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ كَفَرُواْ يُعَلِّمُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ ٱلسِّحۡرَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَى ٱلۡمَلَكَيۡنِ بِبَابِلَ هَٰرُوتَ وَمَٰرُوتَۚ وَمَا يُعَلِّمَانِ مِنۡ أَحَدٍ حَتَّىٰ يَقُولَآ إِنَّمَا نَحۡنُ فِتۡنَةٞ فَلَا تَكۡفُرۡۖ فَيَتَعَلَّمُونَ مِنۡهُمَا مَا يُفَرِّقُونَ بِهِۦ بَيۡنَ ٱلۡمَرۡءِ وَزَوۡجِهِۦۚ وَمَا هُم بِضَآرِّينَ بِهِۦ مِنۡ أَحَدٍ إِلَّا بِإِذۡنِ ٱللَّهِۚ وَيَتَعَلَّمُونَ مَا يَضُرُّهُمۡ وَلَا يَنفَعُهُمۡۚ وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمُواْ لَمَنِ ٱشۡتَرَىٰهُ مَا لَهُۥ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ مِنۡ خَلَٰقٖۚ وَلَبِئۡسَ مَا شَرَوۡاْ بِهِۦٓ أَنفُسَهُمۡۚ لَوۡ كَانُواْ يَعۡلَمُونَ ١٠٢
2:102.t: وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَا تَتْلُوا۟ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ عَلَىٰ مُلْكِ سُلَيْمَٰنَ وَمَا كَفَرَ سُلَيْمَٰنُ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُعَلِّمُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ ٱلسِّحْرَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَى ٱلْمَلَكَيْنِ بِبَابِلَ هَٰرُوتَ وَمَٰرُوتَ وَمَا يُعَلِّمَانِ مِنْ أَحَدٍ حَتَّىٰ يَقُولَآ إِنَّمَا نَحْنُ فِتْنَةٌ فَلَا تَكْفُرْ فَيَتَعَلَّمُونَ مِنْهُمَا مَا يُفَرِّقُونَ بِهِۦ بَيْنَ ٱلْمَرْءِ وَزَوْجِهِۦ وَمَا هُم بِضَآرِّينَ بِهِۦ مِنْ أَحَدٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَتَعَلَّمُونَ مَا يَضُرُّهُمْ وَلَا يَنفَعُهُمْ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمُوا۟ لَمَنِ ٱشْتَرَىٰهُ مَا لَهُۥ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ مِنْ خَلَٰقٍ وَلَبِئْسَ مَا شَرَوْا۟ بِهِۦٓ أَنفُسَهُمْ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
2:102.tr: Wattaba'oo ma tatloo ashshayateenu 'ala mulki sulaymana wama kafara sulaymanu walakinna ashshayateena kafaroo yu'allimoona annasa assihra wama onzila 'ala almalakayni bibabila haroota wamaroota wama yu'allimani min ahadin hatta yaqoola innama nahnu fitnatun fala takfur fayata'allamoona minhuma ma yufarriqoona bihi bayna almari wazawjihi wama hum bidarreena bihi min ahadin illa biithni Allahi wayata'allamoona ma yadurruhum wala yanfa'uhum walaqad 'alimoo lamani ishtarahu ma lahu fee alakhirati min khalaqin walabisa ma sharaw bihi anfusahum law kanoo ya'lamoon
2:102.en: And they followed [instead] what the devils had recited during the reign of Solomon. It was not Solomon who disbelieved, but the devils disbelieved, teaching people magic and that which was revealed to the two angels at Babylon, Harut and Marut. But the two angels do not teach anyone unless they say, "We are a trial, so do not disbelieve [by practicing magic]." And [yet] they learn from them that by which they cause separation between a man and his wife. But they do not harm anyone through it except by permission of Allah. And the people learn what harms them and does not benefit them. But the Children of Israel certainly knew that whoever purchased the magic would not have in the Hereafter any share. And wretched is that for which they sold themselves, if they only knew.
2:102.sw: Na wakafuata yale waliyo zua mashet'ani kuuzulia ufalme wa Su leiman. Na wala Suleiman hakukufuru, bali mashet'ani ndio walio kufuru, wakiwafundisha watu uchawi, na yaliyo teremshwa kwa Malaika wawili, Haaruta na Maaruta katika Baabil. Wala hao hawakumfundisha yeyote mpaka wamwambie: Hakika sisi ni mtihani; basi usikufuru. Wakajifunza kwa hao wawili yale ya kumfarikisha mtu na mkewe. Wala hawawezi kumdhuru mtu ila kwa kutaka Mwenyezi Mungu. Na wanajifunza yatayo wadhuru wala hayawanufaishi. Na hakika wanajua kwamba aliye khiari haya hatakuwa na fungu lolote katika Akhera. Na hakika ni kiovu mno walicho jiuzia nafsi zao laiti wangelijua.

2:163.h: وَإِلَٰهُكُمۡ إِلَٰهٞ وَٰحِدٞۖ لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ ١٦٣
2:163.t: وَإِلَٰهُكُمْ إِلَٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
2:163.tr: Wailahukum ilahun wahidun la ilaha illa huwa arrahmanu arraheem
2:163.en: And your god is one God. There is no deity [worthy of worship] except Him, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
2:163.sw: Na Mungu wenu ni Mungu mmoja tu, hapana mungu ila Yeye. Mwingi wa rehema, Mwenye kurehemu.
