2:164.h: إِنَّ فِي خَلۡقِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَٱخۡتِلَٰفِ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَٱلۡفُلۡكِ ٱلَّتِي تَجۡرِي فِي ٱلۡبَحۡرِ بِمَا يَنفَعُ ٱلنَّاسَ وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مِن مَّآءٖ فَأَحۡيَا بِهِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ مَوۡتِهَا وَبَثَّ فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ دَآبَّةٖ وَتَصۡرِيفِ ٱلرِّيَٰحِ وَٱلسَّحَابِ ٱلۡمُسَخَّرِ بَيۡنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَعۡقِلُونَ ١٦٤
2:164.t: إِنَّ فِى خَلْقِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱخْتِلَٰفِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلَّتِى تَجْرِى فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ بِمَا يَنفَعُ ٱلنَّاسَ وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مِن مَّآءٍ فَأَحْيَا بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا وَبَثَّ فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ دَآبَّةٍ وَتَصْرِيفِ ٱلرِّيَٰحِ وَٱلسَّحَابِ ٱلْمُسَخَّرِ بَيْنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ لَـَٔايَٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ
2:164.tr: Inna fee khalqi assamawati walardi wakhtilafi allayli wannahari walfulki allatee tajree fee albahri bima yanfa'u annasa wama anzala Allahu mina assamai min main faahya bihi alarda ba'da mawtiha wabaththa feeha min kulli dabbatin watasreefi arriyahi wassahabi almusakhkhari bayna assamai walardi laayatin liqawmin ya'qiloon
2:164.en: Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and earth, and the alternation of the night and the day, and the [great] ships which sail through the sea with that which benefits people, and what Allah has sent down from the heavens of rain, giving life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness and dispersing therein every [kind of] moving creature, and [His] directing of the winds and the clouds controlled between the heaven and the earth are signs for a people who use reason.
2:164.sw: Hakika katika kuumbwa kwa mbingu na ardhi, na kukhitalifiana usiku na mchana, na marikebu ambazo hupita baharini kwa viwafaavyo watu, na maji anayo yateremsha Mwenyezi Mungu kutoka mbinguni, na kwa hayo akaihuisha ardhi baada ya kufa kwake, na akaeneza humo kila aina ya wanyama; na katika mabadiliko ya pepo, na mawingu yanayo amrishwa kupita baina ya mbingu na ardhi, bila shaka zimo Ishara kwa watu wanao zingatia.

2:255.h: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلۡحَيُّ ٱلۡقَيُّومُۚ لَا تَأۡخُذُهُۥ سِنَةٞ وَلَا نَوۡمٞۚ لَّهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِي يَشۡفَعُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِإِذۡنِهِۦۚ يَعۡلَمُ مَا بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَهُمۡۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيۡءٖ مِّنۡ عِلۡمِهِۦٓ إِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَۚ وَسِعَ كُرۡسِيُّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَۖ وَلَا يَـُٔودُهُۥ حِفۡظُهُمَاۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَلِيُّ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ ٢٥٥
2:255.t: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ لَا تَأْخُذُهُۥ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ لَّهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِۦ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَىْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَلَا يَـُٔودُهُۥ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
2:255.tr: Allahu la ilaha illa huwa alhayyu alqayyoomu la takhuthuhu sinatun wala nawmun lahu ma fee assamawati wama fee alardi man tha allathee yashfa'u 'indahu illa biithnihi ya'lamu ma bayna aydeehim wama khalfahum wala yuheetoona bishayin min 'ilmihi illa bima shaa wasi'a kursiyyuhu assamawati walarda wala yaooduhu hifthuhuma wahuwa al'aliyyu al'atheem
2:255.en: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of [all] existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
2:255.sw: Mwenyezi Mungu - hapana mungu ila Yeye Aliye hai, Msimamia mambo yote milele. Hashikwi na usingizi wala kulala. Ni vyake pekee vyote viliomo mbinguni na duniani. Ni nani huyo awezaye kuombea mbele yake bila ya idhini yake? Anayajua yaliyo mbele yao na yaliyo nyuma yao; wala wao hawajui chochote katika vilio katika ujuzi wake, ila kwa atakalo mwenyewe. Enzi yake imetanda mbinguni na duniani; na wala haemewi na kuvilinda hivyo. Na Yeye ndiye aliye juu, na ndiye Mkuu.

2:285.h: ءَامَنَ ٱلرَّسُولُ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيۡهِ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَۚ كُلٌّ ءَامَنَ بِٱللَّهِ وَمَلَٰٓئِكَتِهِۦ وَكُتُبِهِۦ وَرُسُلِهِۦ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيۡنَ أَحَدٖ مِّن رُّسُلِهِۦۚ وَقَالُواْ سَمِعۡنَا وَأَطَعۡنَاۖ غُفۡرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيۡكَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ ٢٨٥
2:285.t: ءَامَنَ ٱلرَّسُولُ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ كُلٌّ ءَامَنَ بِٱللَّهِ وَمَلَٰٓئِكَتِهِۦ وَكُتُبِهِۦ وَرُسُلِهِۦ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّن رُّسُلِهِۦ وَقَالُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
2:285.tr: Amana arrasoolu bima onzila ilayhi min rabbihi walmuminoona kullun amana billahi wamalaikatihi wakutubihi warusulihi la nufarriqu bayna ahadin min rusulihi waqaloo sami'na waata'na ghufranaka rabbana wailayka almaseer
2:285.en: The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and [so have] the believers. All of them have believed in Allah and His angels and His books and His messengers, [saying], "We make no distinction between any of His messengers." And they say, "We hear and we obey. [We seek] Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the [final] destination."
2:285.sw: Mtume ameamini yaliyo teremshwa kwake kutoka kwa Mola Mlezi wake, na Waumini vile vile. Wote wamemuamini Mwenyezi Mungu, na Malaika wake, na Vitabu vyake na Mitume wake. Hatutafautishi baina ya yeyote katika Mitume wake, na (Waumini) husema: Tumesikia na tumet'ii. Tunakutaka maghfira Mola Mlezi wetu! Na marejeo ni kwako.

2:286.h: لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفۡسًا إِلَّا وُسۡعَهَاۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتۡ وَعَلَيۡهَا مَا ٱكۡتَسَبَتۡۗ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذۡنَآ إِن نَّسِينَآ أَوۡ أَخۡطَأۡنَاۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحۡمِلۡ عَلَيۡنَآ إِصۡرٗا كَمَا حَمَلۡتَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِنَاۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلۡنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِۦۖ وَٱعۡفُ عَنَّا وَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَا وَٱرۡحَمۡنَآۚ أَنتَ مَوۡلَىٰنَا فَٱنصُرۡنَا عَلَى ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ ٢٨٦
2:286.t: لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا ٱكْتَسَبَتْ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَآ إِن نَّسِينَآ أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَآ إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِۦ وَٱعْفُ عَنَّا وَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَآ أَنتَ مَوْلَىٰنَا فَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
2:286.tr: La yukallifu Allahu nafsan illa wus'aha laha ma kasabat wa'alayha ma iktasabat rabbana la tuakhithna in naseena aw akhtana rabbana wala tahmil 'alayna isran kama hamaltahu 'ala allatheena min qablina rabbana wala tuhammilna ma la taqata lana bihi wa'fu 'anna waghfir lana warhamna anta mawlana fansurna 'ala alqawmi alkafireen
2:286.en: Allah does not charge a soul except [with that within] its capacity. It will have [the consequence of] what [good] it has gained, and it will bear [the consequence of] what [evil] it has earned. "Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred. Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people."
2:286.sw: Mwenyezi Mungu haikalifishi nafsi yoyote ila kwa kadiri ya iwezavyho. Faida ya iliyo yachuma ni yake, na khasara ya iliyo yachuma ni juu yake pia. (Ombeni:) Mola wetu Mlezi! Usituchukulie tukisahau au tukikosea. Mola wetu Mlezi! Usitubebeshe mzigo kama ulio wabebesha wale walio kuwa kabla yetu. Mola wetu Mlezi Usitutwike tusiyo yaweza, na utusamehe, na utughufirie, na uturehemu. Wewe ndiye Mlinzi wetu. Basi tupe ushindi tuwashinde kaumu ya makafiri.

3:18.h: شَهِدَ ٱللَّهُ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ وَٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَأُوْلُواْ ٱلۡعِلۡمِ قَآئِمَۢا بِٱلۡقِسۡطِۚ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ ١٨
3:18.t: شَهِدَ ٱللَّهُ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَأُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمِ قَآئِمًۢا بِٱلْقِسْطِ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
3:18.tr: Shahida Allahu annahu la ilaha illa huwa walmalaikatu waoloo al'ilmi qaiman bilqisti la ilaha illa huwa al'azeezu alhakeem
3:18.en: Allah witnesses that there is no deity except Him, and [so do] the angels and those of knowledge - [that He is] maintaining [creation] in justice. There is no deity except Him, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
3:18.sw: Mwenyezi Mungu, na Malaika, na wenye ilimu, wameshuhudia kuwa hakika hapana mungu ila Yeye, ndiye Mwenye kusimamisha uadilifu; hapana mungu ila Yeye Mwenye nguvu na Mwenye hikima.

3:19.h: إِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡإِسۡلَٰمُۗ وَمَا ٱخۡتَلَفَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡعِلۡمُ بَغۡيَۢا بَيۡنَهُمۡۗ وَمَن يَكۡفُرۡ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلۡحِسَابِ ١٩
3:19.t: إِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْإِسْلَٰمُ وَمَا ٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْعِلْمُ بَغْيًۢا بَيْنَهُمْ وَمَن يَكْفُرْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ
3:19.tr: Inna addeena 'inda Allahi alislamu wama ikhtalafa allatheena ootoo alkitaba illa min ba'di ma jaahumu al'ilmu baghyan baynahum waman yakfur biayati Allahi fainna Allaha saree'u alhisab
3:19.en: Indeed, the religion in the sight of Allah is Islam. And those who were given the Scripture did not differ except after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. And whoever disbelieves in the verses of Allah, then indeed, Allah is swift in [taking] account.
3:19.sw: Bila ya shaka Dini mbele ya Mwenyezi Mungu ni Uislamu. Na walio pewa Kitabu hawakukhitalifiana ila baada ya kuwajia ujuzi, kwa sababu ya uhasidi ulio kuwa baina yao. Na anaye zikataa Ishara za Mwenyezi Mungu basi hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mwepesi wa kuhisabu.

7:54.h: إِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٖ ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلۡعَرۡشِۖ يُغۡشِي ٱلَّيۡلَ ٱلنَّهَارَ يَطۡلُبُهُۥ حَثِيثٗا وَٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَ وَٱلنُّجُومَ مُسَخَّرَٰتِۭ بِأَمۡرِهِۦٓۗ أَلَا لَهُ ٱلۡخَلۡقُ وَٱلۡأَمۡرُۗ تَبَارَكَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ ٥٤
7:54.t: إِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ يُغْشِى ٱلَّيْلَ ٱلنَّهَارَ يَطْلُبُهُۥ حَثِيثًا وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ وَٱلنُّجُومَ مُسَخَّرَٰتٍۭ بِأَمْرِهِۦٓ أَلَا لَهُ ٱلْخَلْقُ وَٱلْأَمْرُ تَبَارَكَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
7:54.tr: Inna rabbakumu Allahu allathee khalaqa assamawati walarda fee sittati ayyamin thumma istawa 'ala al'arshi yughshee allayla annahara yatlubuhu hatheethan washshamsa walqamara wannujooma musakhkharatin biamrihi ala lahu alkhalqu walamru tabaraka Allahu rabbu al'alameen
7:54.en: Indeed, your Lord is Allah, who created the heavens and earth in six days and then established Himself above the Throne. He covers the night with the day, [another night] chasing it rapidly; and [He created] the sun, the moon, and the stars, subjected by His command. Unquestionably, His is the creation and the command; blessed is Allah, Lord of the worlds.
7:54.sw: Hakika Mola Mlezi wenu ni Mwenyezi Mungu aliye ziumba mbingu na ardhi katika siku sita. Kisha akatawala juu ya Kiti cha Enzi. Huufunika usiku kwa mchana, ufuatao upesi upesi. Na jua, na mwezi, na nyota zinazo tumika kwa amri yake. Fahamuni! Kuumba na amri ni zake. Ametukuka kabisa Mwenyezi Mungu, Mola Mlezi wa viumbe vyote.

7:55.h: ٱدۡعُواْ رَبَّكُمۡ تَضَرُّعٗا وَخُفۡيَةًۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلۡمُعۡتَدِينَ ٥٥
7:55.t: ٱدْعُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ تَضَرُّعًا وَخُفْيَةً إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُعْتَدِينَ
7:55.tr: Od'oo rabbakum tadarru'an wakhufyatan innahu la yuhibbu almu'tadeen
7:55.en: Call upon your Lord in humility and privately; indeed, He does not like transgressors.
7:55.sw: Muombeni Mola wenu Mlezi kwa unyenyekevu na kwa siri. Hakika Yeye hawapendi warukao mipaka.

7:56.h: وَلَا تُفۡسِدُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ بَعۡدَ إِصۡلَٰحِهَا وَٱدۡعُوهُ خَوۡفٗا وَطَمَعًاۚ إِنَّ رَحۡمَتَ ٱللَّهِ قَرِيبٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ ٥٦
7:56.t: وَلَا تُفْسِدُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بَعْدَ إِصْلَٰحِهَا وَٱدْعُوهُ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا إِنَّ رَحْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ قَرِيبٌ مِّنَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
7:56.tr: Wala tufsidoo fee alardi ba'da islahiha wad'oohu khawfan watama'an inna rahmata Allahi qareebun mina almuhsineen
7:56.en: And cause not corruption upon the earth after its reformation. And invoke Him in fear and aspiration. Indeed, the mercy of Allah is near to the doers of good.
7:56.sw: Wala msifanye uharibifu katika nchi baada ya kuwa imekwisha tengenezwa. Na muombeni kwa kuogopa na kwa kutumai. Hakika rehema ya Mwenyzi Mungu iko karibu na wanao fanya mema.

7:117.h: ۞ وَأَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنۡ أَلۡقِ عَصَاكَۖ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَلۡقَفُ مَا يَأۡفِكُونَ ١١٧
7:117.t: وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَلْقِ عَصَاكَ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ
7:117.tr: Waawhayna ila moosa an alqi 'asaka faitha hiya talqafu ma yafikoon
7:117.en: And We inspired to Moses, "Throw your staff," and at once it devoured what they were falsifying.
7:117.sw: Nasi tukamfunulia Musa kumwambia: Tupa fimbo yako. Mara ikavimeza vyote vile walivyo vibuni.

7:118.h: فَوَقَعَ ٱلۡحَقُّ وَبَطَلَ مَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ ١١٨
7:118.t: فَوَقَعَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَبَطَلَ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
7:118.tr: Fawaqa'a alhaqqu wabatala ma kanoo ya'maloon
7:118.en: So the truth was established, and abolished was what they were doing.
7:118.sw: Kweli ikathibiti na yakabat'ilika waliyo kuwa wakiyatenda.

7:119.en: And Pharaoh and his people were overcome right there and became debased.
7:119.sw: Kwa hivyo walishindwa hapo, na wakageuka kuwa wadogo.

7:120.en: And the magicians fell down in prostration [to Allah].

7:121.en: They said, "We have believed in the Lord of the worlds,
7:121.sw: Wakasema: Tumemuamini Mola Mlezi wa viumbe vyote,

7:122.en: The Lord of Moses and Aaron."
7:122.sw: Mola Mlezi wa Musa na Haarun.

10:79.h: وَقَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ ٱئۡتُونِي بِكُلِّ سَٰحِرٍ عَلِيمٖ ٧٩
10:79.t: وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ ٱئْتُونِى بِكُلِّ سَٰحِرٍ عَلِيمٍ
10:79.en: And Pharaoh said, "Bring to me every learned magician."
10:79.sw: Na Firauni akasema: Nileteeni kila mchawi mjuzi!

10:80.h: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلۡقُواْ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلۡقُونَ ٨٠
10:80.t: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلْقُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلْقُونَ
10:80.tr: Falamma jaa assaharatu qala lahum moosa alqoo ma antum mulqoon
10:80.en: So when the magicians came, Moses said to them, "Throw down whatever you will throw."
10:80.sw: Basi walipo kuja wachawi, Musa aliwaambia: Tupeni mnavyo tupa!

10:81.h: فَلَمَّآ أَلۡقَوۡاْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ مَا جِئۡتُم بِهِ ٱلسِّحۡرُۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَيُبۡطِلُهُۥٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُصۡلِحُ عَمَلَ ٱلۡمُفۡسِدِينَ ٨١
10:81.t: فَلَمَّآ أَلْقَوْا۟ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ مَا جِئْتُم بِهِ ٱلسِّحْرُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَيُبْطِلُهُۥٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُصْلِحُ عَمَلَ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
10:81.tr: Falamma alqaw qala moosa ma jitum bihi assihru inna Allaha sayubtiluhu inna Allaha la yuslihu 'amala almufsideen
10:81.en: And when they had thrown, Moses said, "What you have brought is [only] magic. Indeed, Allah will expose its worthlessness. Indeed, Allah does not amend the work of corrupters.
10:81.sw: Walipo tupa, Musa alisema: Mliyo leta ni uchawi. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu haitengenezi kazi ya waharibifu.

10:82.h: وَيُحِقُّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡحَقَّ بِكَلِمَٰتِهِۦ وَلَوۡ كَرِهَ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ ٨٢
10:82.t: وَيُحِقُّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْحَقَّ بِكَلِمَٰتِهِۦ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
10:82.tr: Wayuhiqqu Allahu alhaqqa bikalimatihi walaw kariha almujrimoon
10:82.en: And Allah will establish the truth by His words, even if the criminals dislike it."
10:82.sw: Na Mwenyezi Mungu huhakikisha Haki kwa maneno yake, hata wanga chukia wakosefu

20:65.h: قَالُواْ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِمَّآ أَن تُلۡقِيَ وَإِمَّآ أَن نَّكُونَ أَوَّلَ مَنۡ أَلۡقَىٰ ٦٥
20:65.t: قَالُوا۟ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِمَّآ أَن تُلْقِىَ وَإِمَّآ أَن نَّكُونَ أَوَّلَ مَنْ أَلْقَىٰ
20:65.tr: Qaloo ya moosa imma an tulqiya waimma an nakoona awwala man alqa
20:65.en: They said, "O Moses, either you throw or we will be the first to throw."
20:65.sw: Wakasema: Ewe Musa! Je! Utatupa wewe, au tutakuwa sisi wa kwanza kutupa?

20:66.h: قَالَ بَلۡ أَلۡقُواْۖ فَإِذَا حِبَالُهُمۡ وَعِصِيُّهُمۡ يُخَيَّلُ إِلَيۡهِ مِن سِحۡرِهِمۡ أَنَّهَا تَسۡعَىٰ ٦٦
20:66.t: قَالَ بَلْ أَلْقُوا۟ فَإِذَا حِبَالُهُمْ وَعِصِيُّهُمْ يُخَيَّلُ إِلَيْهِ مِن سِحْرِهِمْ أَنَّهَا تَسْعَىٰ
20:66.tr: Qala bal alqoo faitha hibaluhum wa'isiyyuhum yukhayyalu ilayhi min sihrihim annaha tas'a
20:66.en: He said, "Rather, you throw." And suddenly their ropes and staffs seemed to him from their magic that they were moving [like snakes].
20:66.sw: Akasema: Bali tupeni nyinyi! Tahamaki kamba zao na fimbo zao zikaonekana mbele yake, kwa uchawi wao, kuwa zinapiga mbio.

20:67.en: And he sensed within himself apprehension, did Moses.
20:67.sw: Basi Musa akaingia khofu nafsi yake.

20:68.h: قُلۡنَا لَا تَخَفۡ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ ٦٨
20:68.t: قُلْنَا لَا تَخَفْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
20:68.tr: Qulna la takhaf innaka anta ala'la
20:68.en: Allah said, "Fear not. Indeed, it is you who are superior.
20:68.sw: Tukasema: Usikhofu! Hakika wewe ndiye utakaye shinda.

20:69.h: وَأَلۡقِ مَا فِي يَمِينِكَ تَلۡقَفۡ مَا صَنَعُوٓاْۖ إِنَّمَا صَنَعُواْ كَيۡدُ سَٰحِرٖۖ وَلَا يُفۡلِحُ ٱلسَّاحِرُ حَيۡثُ أَتَىٰ ٦٩
20:69.t: وَأَلْقِ مَا فِى يَمِينِكَ تَلْقَفْ مَا صَنَعُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا صَنَعُوا۟ كَيْدُ سَٰحِرٍ وَلَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلسَّاحِرُ حَيْثُ أَتَىٰ
20:69.tr: Waalqi ma fee yameenika talqaf ma sana'oo innama sana'oo kaydu sahirin wala yuflihu assahiru haythu ata
20:69.en: And throw what is in your right hand; it will swallow up what they have crafted. What they have crafted is but the trick of a magician, and the magician will not succeed wherever he is."
20:69.sw: Na kitupe kilicho katika mkono wako wa kulia; kitavimeza walivyo viunda. Hakika walivyo unda ni hila za mchawi tu, na mchawi hafanikiwi popote afikapo.

23:115.h: أَفَحَسِبۡتُمۡ أَنَّمَا خَلَقۡنَٰكُمۡ عَبَثٗا وَأَنَّكُمۡ إِلَيۡنَا لَا تُرۡجَعُونَ ١١٥
23:115.t: أَفَحَسِبْتُمْ أَنَّمَا خَلَقْنَٰكُمْ عَبَثًا وَأَنَّكُمْ إِلَيْنَا لَا تُرْجَعُونَ
23:115.tr: Afahasibtum annama khalaqnakum 'abathan waannakum ilayna la turja'oon
23:115.en: Then did you think that We created you uselessly and that to Us you would not be returned?"
23:115.sw: Je! Mlidhani ya kwamba tulikuumbeni bure na ya kwamba nyinyi kwetu hamtarudishwa?

23:116.h: فَتَعَٰلَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡمَلِكُ ٱلۡحَقُّۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلۡعَرۡشِ ٱلۡكَرِيمِ ١١٦
23:116.t: فَتَعَٰلَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْحَقُّ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
23:116.tr: Fata'ala Allahu almaliku alhaqqu la ilaha illa huwa rabbu al'arshi alkareem
23:116.en: So exalted is Allah, the Sovereign, the Truth; there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Noble Throne.
23:116.sw: Ametukuka Mwenyezi Mungu, Mfalme wa Haki, hapana mungu ila Yeye, Mola Mlezi wa A'rshi Tukufu.

23:117.h: وَمَن يَدۡعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ لَا بُرۡهَٰنَ لَهُۥ بِهِۦ فَإِنَّمَا حِسَابُهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفۡلِحُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ ١١٧
23:117.t: وَمَن يَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ لَا بُرْهَٰنَ لَهُۥ بِهِۦ فَإِنَّمَا حِسَابُهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦٓ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ
23:117.tr: Waman yad'u ma'a Allahi ilahan akhara la burhana lahu bihi fainnama hisabuhu 'inda rabbihi innahu la yuflihu alkafiroon
23:117.en: And whoever invokes besides Allah another deity for which he has no proof - then his account is only with his Lord. Indeed, the disbelievers will not succeed.
23:117.sw: Na anaye muomba - pamoja na Mwenyezi Mungu - mungu mwenginewe hana ushahidi wa hili; basi bila ya shaka hisabu yake iko kwa Mola wake Mlezi. Kwa hakika makafiri hawafanikiwi.

23:118.h: وَقُل رَّبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ وَٱرۡحَمۡ وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ ١١٨
23:118.t: وَقُل رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ وَٱرْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
23:118.tr: Waqul rabbi ighfir warham waanta khayru arrahimeen
23:118.en: And, [O Muhammad], say, "My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful."
23:118.sw: Nawe sema: Mola wangu Mlezi! Samehe na urehemu nawe ni Mbora wa wanao rehemu.

37:1.en: By those [angels] lined up in rows
37:1.sw: Naapa kwa wanao jipanga kwa safu.

37:3.en: And those who recite the message,

37:4.sw: Hakika Mungu wenu bila ya shaka ni Mmoja.

37:5.h: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ ٱلۡمَشَٰرِقِ ٥
37:5.t: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَشَٰرِقِ
37:5.tr: Rabbu assamawati walardi wama baynahuma warabbu almashariq
37:5.en: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them and Lord of the sunrises.
37:5.sw: Mola Mlezi wa mbingu na ardhi, na yaliyomo kati yao, na ni Mola Mlezi wa mashariki zote.

37:6.h: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا بِزِينَةٍ ٱلۡكَوَاكِبِ ٦
37:6.t: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِزِينَةٍ ٱلْكَوَاكِبِ
37:6.tr: Inna zayyanna assamaa addunya bizeenatin alkawakib
37:6.en: Indeed, We have adorned the nearest heaven with an adornment of stars
37:6.sw: Hakika Sisi tumeipamba mbingu ya karibu kwa pambo la nyota.

37:7.en: And as protection against every rebellious devil
37:7.sw: Na kulinda na kila shet'ani a'si.

37:8.h: لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى ٱلۡمَلَإِ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ وَيُقۡذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبٖ ٨
37:8.t: لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى ٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ وَيُقْذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبٍ
37:8.tr: La yassamma'oona ila almalai ala'la wayuqthafoona min kulli janib
37:8.en: [So] they may not listen to the exalted assembly [of angels] and are pelted from every side,
37:8.sw: Wasiweze kuwasikiliza viumbe watukufu. Na wanafukuzwa huko kila upande.

37:9.en: Repelled; and for them is a constant punishment,
37:9.sw: Wakifurushwa. Na wanayo adhabu ya kudumu.

37:10.h: إِلَّا مَنۡ خَطِفَ ٱلۡخَطۡفَةَ فَأَتۡبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٞ ثَاقِبٞ ١٠
37:10.t: إِلَّا مَنْ خَطِفَ ٱلْخَطْفَةَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌ ثَاقِبٌ
37:10.tr: Illa man khatifa alkhatfata faatba'ahu shihabun thaqib
37:10.en: Except one who snatches [some words] by theft, but they are pursued by a burning flame, piercing [in brightness].
37:10.sw: Isipo kuwa anaye nyakua kitu kidogo, na mara humfwatia kimondo kinacho ng'ara.

46:29.h: وَإِذۡ صَرَفۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ نَفَرٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ يَسۡتَمِعُونَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ فَلَمَّا حَضَرُوهُ قَالُوٓاْ أَنصِتُواْۖ فَلَمَّا قُضِيَ وَلَّوۡاْ إِلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِم مُّنذِرِينَ ٢٩
46:29.t: وَإِذْ صَرَفْنَآ إِلَيْكَ نَفَرًا مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ يَسْتَمِعُونَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ فَلَمَّا حَضَرُوهُ قَالُوٓا۟ أَنصِتُوا۟ فَلَمَّا قُضِىَ وَلَّوْا۟ إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِم مُّنذِرِينَ
46:29.tr: Waith sarafna ilayka nafaran mina aljinni yastami'oona alqurana falamma hadaroohu qaloo ansitoo falamma qudiya wallaw ila qawmihim munthireen
46:29.en: And [mention, O Muhammad], when We directed to you a few of the jinn, listening to the Qur'an. And when they attended it, they said, "Listen quietly." And when it was concluded, they went back to their people as warners.
46:29.sw: Na wakati tulipo waleta kundi la majini kuja kwako kusikiliza Qur'ani. Basi walipo ihudhuria walisema: Sikilizeni! Na ilipo kwisha somwa, walirudi kwa kaumu yao kwenda kuwaonya.

46:30.h: قَالُواْ يَٰقَوۡمَنَآ إِنَّا سَمِعۡنَا كِتَٰبًا أُنزِلَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مُوسَىٰ مُصَدِّقٗا لِّمَا بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡهِ يَهۡدِيٓ إِلَى ٱلۡحَقِّ وَإِلَىٰ طَرِيقٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ ٣٠
46:30.t: قَالُوا۟ يَٰقَوْمَنَآ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا كِتَٰبًا أُنزِلَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مُوسَىٰ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلْحَقِّ وَإِلَىٰ طَرِيقٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
46:30.tr: Qaloo ya qawmana inna sami'na kitaban onzila min ba'di moosa musaddiqan lima bayna yadayhi yahdee ila alhaqqi waila tareeqin mustaqeem
46:30.en: They said, "O our people, indeed we have heard a [recited] Book revealed after Moses confirming what was before it which guides to the truth and to a straight path.
46:30.sw: Wakasema: Enyi kaumu yetu! Sisi tumesikia Kitabu kilicho teremshwa baada ya Musa, kinacho sadikisha yaliyo kuwa kabla yake, na kinacho ongoza kwenye Haki na kwenye Njia Iliyo Nyooka.

46:31.h: يَٰقَوۡمَنَآ أَجِيبُواْ دَاعِيَ ٱللَّهِ وَءَامِنُواْ بِهِۦ يَغۡفِرۡ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمۡ وَيُجِرۡكُم مِّنۡ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٖ ٣١
46:31.t: يَٰقَوْمَنَآ أَجِيبُوا۟ دَاعِىَ ٱللَّهِ وَءَامِنُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُجِرْكُم مِّنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
46:31.tr: Ya qawmana ajeeboo da'iya Allahi waaminoo bihi yaghfir lakum min thunoobikum wayujirkum min 'athabin aleem
46:31.en: O our people, respond to the Messenger of Allah and believe in him; Allah will forgive for you your sins and protect you from a painful punishment.
46:31.sw: Enyi kaumu yetu! Muitikieni Mwenye kuitia kwa Mwenyezi Mungu, na muaminini, Mwenyezi Mungu atakusameheni, na atakukingeni na adhabu chungu.

46:32.h: وَمَن لَّا يُجِبۡ دَاعِيَ ٱللَّهِ فَلَيۡسَ بِمُعۡجِزٖ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَيۡسَ لَهُۥ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوۡلِيَآءُۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٍ ٣٢
46:32.t: وَمَن لَّا يُجِبْ دَاعِىَ ٱللَّهِ فَلَيْسَ بِمُعْجِزٍ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَيْسَ لَهُۥ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوْلِيَآءُ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
46:32.tr: Waman la yujib da'iya Allahi falaysa bimu'jizin fee alardi walaysa lahu min doonihi awliyaa olaika fee dalalin mubeen
46:32.en: But he who does not respond to the Caller of Allah will not cause failure [to Him] upon earth, and he will not have besides Him any protectors. Those are in manifest error."
46:32.sw: Na wasio mwitikia Mwitaji wa Mwenyezi Mungu basi hao hawatashinda katika ardhi, wala hawatakuwa na walinzi mbele yake. Hao wamo katika upotovu ulio dhaahiri.

55:33.h: يَٰمَعۡشَرَ ٱلۡجِنِّ وَٱلۡإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسۡتَطَعۡتُمۡ أَن تَنفُذُواْ مِنۡ أَقۡطَارِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَٱنفُذُواْۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلۡطَٰنٖ ٣٣
55:33.t: يَٰمَعْشَرَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَن تَنفُذُوا۟ مِنْ أَقْطَارِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنفُذُوا۟ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلْطَٰنٍ
55:33.tr: Ya ma'shara aljinni walinsi ini istata'tum an tanfuthoo min aqtari assamawati walardi fanfuthoo la tanfuthoona illa bisultan
55:33.en: O company of jinn and mankind, if you are able to pass beyond the regions of the heavens and the earth, then pass. You will not pass except by authority [from Allah].
55:33.sw: Enyi makundi ya majini na watu! Mkiweza kupenya kwenye mbingu na ardhi, basi penyeni! Hamtapenya ila kwa kupewa madaraka.

55:34.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
55:34.sw: Basi ni ipi katika neema za Mola wenu Mlezi mnayo ikanusha?

55:35.h: يُرۡسَلُ عَلَيۡكُمَا شُوَاظٞ مِّن نَّارٖ وَنُحَاسٞ فَلَا تَنتَصِرَانِ ٣٥
55:35.t: يُرْسَلُ عَلَيْكُمَا شُوَاظٌ مِّن نَّارٍ وَنُحَاسٌ فَلَا تَنتَصِرَانِ
55:35.tr: Yursalu 'alaykuma shuwathun min narin wanuhasun fala tantasiran
55:35.en: There will be sent upon you a flame of fire and smoke, and you will not defend yourselves.
55:35.sw: Mtapelekewa muwako wa moto na shaba; wala hamtashinda.

55:36.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
55:36.sw: Basi ni ipi katika neema za Mola wenu Mlezi mnayo ikanusha?

59:21.h: لَوۡ أَنزَلۡنَا هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ عَلَىٰ جَبَلٖ لَّرَأَيۡتَهُۥ خَٰشِعٗا مُّتَصَدِّعٗا مِّنۡ خَشۡيَةِ ٱللَّهِۚ وَتِلۡكَ ٱلۡأَمۡثَٰلُ نَضۡرِبُهَا لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ ٢١
59:21.t: لَوْ أَنزَلْنَا هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ عَلَىٰ جَبَلٍ لَّرَأَيْتَهُۥ خَٰشِعًا مُّتَصَدِّعًا مِّنْ خَشْيَةِ ٱللَّهِ وَتِلْكَ ٱلْأَمْثَٰلُ نَضْرِبُهَا لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
59:21.tr: Law anzalna hatha alqurana 'ala jabalin laraaytahu khashi'an mutasaddi'an min khashyati Allahi watilka alamthalu nadribuha linnasi la'allahum yatafakkaroon
59:21.en: If We had sent down this Qur'an upon a mountain, you would have seen it humbled and coming apart from fear of Allah. And these examples We present to the people that perhaps they will give thought.
59:21.sw: Lau kuwa tumeiteremsha hii Qur'ani juu ya mlima, basi bila ya shaka ungeli uona ukinyenyekea, ukipasuka kwa khofu ya Mwenyezi Mungu. Na hiyo mifano tunawapigia watu ili wafikiri.

59:22.h: هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ عَٰلِمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِۖ هُوَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ ٢٢
59:22.t: هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
59:22.tr: Huwa Allahu allathee la ilaha illa huwa 'alimu alghaybi washshahadati huwa arrahmanu arraheem
59:22.en: He is Allah, other than whom there is no deity, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed. He is the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
59:22.sw: Yeye ndiye Mwenyezi Mungu, ambaye hapana mungu isipo kuwa Yeye tu. Mwenye kuyajua yaliyo fichikana na yanayo onekana. Yeye ndiye Mwingi wa rehema, Mwenye kurehemu.

59:23.h: هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلۡمَلِكُ ٱلۡقُدُّوسُ ٱلسَّلَٰمُ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُ ٱلۡمُهَيۡمِنُ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡجَبَّارُ ٱلۡمُتَكَبِّرُۚ سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ ٢٣
59:23.t: هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْقُدُّوسُ ٱلسَّلَٰمُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُ ٱلْمُهَيْمِنُ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْجَبَّارُ ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرُ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
59:23.tr: Huwa Allahu allathee la ilaha illa huwa almaliku alquddoosu assalamu almuminu almuhayminu al'azeezu aljabbaru almutakabbiru subhana Allahi 'amma yushrikoon
59:23.en: He is Allah, other than whom there is no deity, the Sovereign, the Pure, the Perfection, the Bestower of Faith, the Overseer, the Exalted in Might, the Compeller, the Superior. Exalted is Allah above whatever they associate with Him.
59:23.sw: Yeye ndiye Mwenyezi Mungu ambaye hapana mungu isipo kuwa Yeye tu. Mfalme, Mtakatifu, Mwenye salama, Mtoaji wa amani, Mwenye kuyaendesha Mwenyewe mambo yake, Mwenye nguvu, Anaye fanya analo litaka, Mkubwa, Ametakasika Mwenyezi Mungu na hayo wanayo mshirikisha nayo.

59:24.h: هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡخَٰلِقُ ٱلۡبَارِئُ ٱلۡمُصَوِّرُۖ لَهُ ٱلۡأَسۡمَآءُ ٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰۚ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ ٢٤
59:24.t: هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْخَٰلِقُ ٱلْبَارِئُ ٱلْمُصَوِّرُ لَهُ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
59:24.tr: Huwa Allahu alkhaliqu albario almusawwiru lahu alasmao alhusna yusabbihu lahu ma fee assamawati walardi wahuwa al'azeezu alhakeem
59:24.en: He is Allah, the Creator, the Inventor, the Fashioner; to Him belong the best names. Whatever is in the heavens and earth is exalting Him. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
59:24.sw: Yeye ndiye Mwenyezi Mungu, Muumbaji, Mtengenezaji, Mtia sura, Mwenye majina mazuri kabisa. Kila kilioko katika mbingu na ardhi kinamtakasa, naye ni Mwenye kushinda, Mwenye hikima.

72:1.h: قُلۡ أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسۡتَمَعَ نَفَرٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا سَمِعۡنَا قُرۡءَانًا عَجَبٗا ١
72:1.t: قُلْ أُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْءَانًا عَجَبًا
72:1.tr: Qul oohiya ilayya annahu istama'a nafarun mina aljinni faqaloo inna sami'na quranan 'ajaba
72:1.en: Say, [O Muhammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur'an.
72:1.sw: Sema: Imefunuliwa kwangu ya kuwa kundi moja la majini lilisikiliza, na likasema: Hakika sisi tumeisikia Qur'ani ya ajabu!

72:2.h: يَهۡدِيٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشۡدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦۖ وَلَن نُّشۡرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدٗا ٢
72:2.t: يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشْدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدًا
72:2.tr: Yahdee ila arrushdi faamanna bihi walan nushrika birabbina ahada
72:2.en: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone.
72:2.sw: Inaongoza kwenye uwongofu, kwa hivyo tumeiamini, wala hatutamshirikisha yeyote na Mola wetu Mlezi.

72:3.h: وَأَنَّهُۥ تَعَٰلَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَٰحِبَةٗ وَلَا وَلَدٗا ٣
72:3.t: وَأَنَّهُۥ تَعَٰلَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَٰحِبَةً وَلَا وَلَدًا
72:3.tr: Waannahu ta'ala jaddu rabbina ma ittakhatha sahibatan wala walada
72:3.en: And [it teaches] that exalted is the nobleness of our Lord; He has not taken a wife or a son
72:3.sw: Na kwa hakika utukufu wa Mola wetu Mlezi umetukuka kabisa; hana mke wala mwana.

72:4.h: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ شَطَطٗا ٤
72:4.t: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ شَطَطًا
72:4.tr: Waannahu kana yaqoolu safeehuna 'ala Allahi shatata
72:4.en: And that our foolish one has been saying about Allah an excessive transgression.
72:4.sw: Na kwa hakika wapumbavu miongoni mwetu walikuwa wakisema uwongo ulio pindukia mipaka juu ya Mwenyezi Mungu.

72:5.h: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن تَقُولَ ٱلۡإِنسُ وَٱلۡجِنُّ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبٗا ٥
72:5.t: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن تَقُولَ ٱلْإِنسُ وَٱلْجِنُّ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا
72:5.tr: Waanna thananna an lan taqoola alinsu waljinnu 'ala Allahi kathiba
72:5.en: And we had thought that mankind and the jinn would never speak about Allah a lie.
72:5.sw: Nasi tulidhani kuwa watu na majini hawamzulii uwongo Mwenyezi Mungu.

72:6.h: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ رِجَالٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمۡ رَهَقٗا ٦
72:6.t: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ رِجَالٌ مِّنَ ٱلْإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقًا
72:6.tr: Waannahu kana rijalun mina alinsi ya'oothoona birijalin mina aljinni fazadoohum rahaqa
72:6.en: And there were men from mankind who sought refuge in men from the jinn, so they [only] increased them in burden.
72:6.sw: Na hakika walikuwako wanaume katika watu walio kuwa wakitafuta kujikinga kwa wanaume wa kijini; kwa hivyo wakawazidisha madhambi.

72:7.h: وَأَنَّهُمۡ ظَنُّواْ كَمَا ظَنَنتُمۡ أَن لَّن يَبۡعَثَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٗا ٧
72:7.t: وَأَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّوا۟ كَمَا ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدًا
72:7.tr: Waannahum thannoo kama thanantum an lan yab'atha Allahu ahada
72:7.en: And they had thought, as you thought, that Allah would never send anyone [as a messenger].
72:7.sw: Na kwa hakika wao walidhani, kama mlivyo dhani nyinyi, ya kuwa Mwenyezi Mungu hatamleta Mtume.

72:8.h: وَأَنَّا لَمَسۡنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدۡنَٰهَا مُلِئَتۡ حَرَسٗا شَدِيدٗا وَشُهُبٗا ٨
72:8.t: وَأَنَّا لَمَسْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدْنَٰهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَسًا شَدِيدًا وَشُهُبًا
72:8.tr: Waanna lamasna assamaa fawajadnaha muliat harasan shadeedan washuhuba
72:8.en: And we have sought [to reach] the heaven but found it filled with powerful guards and burning flames.
72:8.sw: Nasi tulizigusa mbingu, na tukaziona zimejaa walinzi wenye nguvu na vimondo.

72:9.h: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقۡعُدُ مِنۡهَا مَقَٰعِدَ لِلسَّمۡعِۖ فَمَن يَسۡتَمِعِ ٱلۡأٓنَ يَجِدۡ لَهُۥ شِهَابٗا رَّصَدٗا ٩
72:9.t: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَٰعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ فَمَن يَسْتَمِعِ ٱلْـَٔانَ يَجِدْ لَهُۥ شِهَابًا رَّصَدًا
72:9.tr: Waanna kunna naq'udu minha maqa'ida lissam'i faman yastami'i alana yajid lahu shihaban rasada
72:9.en: And we used to sit therein in positions for hearing, but whoever listens now will find a burning flame lying in wait for him.
72:9.sw: Na hakika tulikuwa tukikaa humo katika baadhi ya makao ili kusikiliza; lakini sasa anaye taka kusikiliza atakuta kimondo kinamvizia!

67:3.h: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبۡعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٖ طِبَاقٗاۖ مَّا تَرَىٰ فِي خَلۡقِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ مِن تَفَٰوُتٖۖ فَٱرۡجِعِ ٱلۡبَصَرَ هَلۡ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورٖ ٣
67:3.t: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٍ طِبَاقًا مَّا تَرَىٰ فِى خَلْقِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ مِن تَفَٰوُتٍ فَٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ هَلْ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورٍ
67:3.tr: Allathee khalaqa sab'a samawatin tibaqan ma tara fee khalqi arrahmani min tafawutin farji'i albasara hal tara min futoor
67:3.en: [And] who created seven heavens in layers. You do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency. So return [your] vision [to the sky]; do you see any breaks?
67:3.sw: Aliye umba mbingu saba kwa matabaka. Huoni tafauti yoyote katika uumbaji wa Mwingi wa Rehema. Hebu rudisha nadhari! Unaona kosa lolote?

67:4.h: ثُمَّ ٱرۡجِعِ ٱلۡبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيۡنِ يَنقَلِبۡ إِلَيۡكَ ٱلۡبَصَرُ خَاسِئٗا وَهُوَ حَسِيرٞ ٤
67:4.t: ثُمَّ ٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيْنِ يَنقَلِبْ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْبَصَرُ خَاسِئًا وَهُوَ حَسِيرٌ
67:4.tr: Thumma irji'i albasara karratayni yanqalib ilayka albasaru khasian wahuwa haseer
67:4.en: Then return [your] vision twice again. [Your] vision will return to you humbled while it is fatigued.
67:4.sw: Tena rudisha nadhari mara mbili, nadhari yako itakurejea mwenyewe hali ya kuwa imehizika nayo imechoka.

68:51.h: وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَيُزۡلِقُونَكَ بِأَبۡصَٰرِهِمۡ لَمَّا سَمِعُواْ ٱلذِّكۡرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجۡنُونٞ ٥١
68:51.t: وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصَٰرِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُوا۟ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجْنُونٌ
68:51.tr: Wain yakadu allatheena kafaroo layuzliqoonaka biabsarihim lamma sami'oo aththikra wayaqooloona innahu lamajnoon
68:51.en: And indeed, those who disbelieve would almost make you slip with their eyes when they hear the message, and they say, "Indeed, he is mad."
68:51.sw: Na walio kufuru hukaribia kukutelezesha kwa macho yao, wanapo sikia mawaidha, na wanasema: Hakika yeye ni mwendawazimu.

68:52.en: But it is not except a reminder to the worlds.
68:52.sw: Na hayakuwa haya, ila ni ukumbusho kwa walimwengu wote.

13:28.h: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَتَطۡمَئِنُّ قُلُوبُهُم بِذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِۗ أَلَا بِذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِ تَطۡمَئِنُّ ٱلۡقُلُوبُ ٢٨
13:28.t: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَطْمَئِنُّ قُلُوبُهُم بِذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ أَلَا بِذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ ٱلْقُلُوبُ
13:28.tr: Allatheena amanoo watatmainnu quloobuhum bithikri Allahi ala bithikri Allahi tatmainnu alquloob
13:28.en: Those who have believed and whose hearts are assured by the remembrance of Allah. Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah hearts are assured."
13:28.sw: Wale walio amini na zikatua nyoyo zao kwa kumkumbuka Mwenyezi Mungu. Hakika kwa kumkumbuka Mwenyezi Mungu ndio nyoyo hutua!

17:82.h: وَنُنَزِّلُ مِنَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ مَا هُوَ شِفَآءٞ وَرَحۡمَةٞ لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَلَا يَزِيدُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا خَسَارٗا ٨٢
17:82.t: وَنُنَزِّلُ مِنَ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَا هُوَ شِفَآءٌ وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَلَا يَزِيدُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا خَسَارًا
17:82.tr: Wanunazzilu mina alqurani ma huwa shifaon warahmatun lilmumineena wala yazeedu aththalimeena illa khasara
17:82.en: And We send down of the Qur'an that which is healing and mercy for the believers, but it does not increase the wrongdoers except in loss.
17:82.sw: Na tunateremsha katika Qur'ani yaliyo ni matibabu na rehema kwa Waumini. Wala hayawazidishii madhaalimu ila khasara.

9:14.h: قَٰتِلُوهُمۡ يُعَذِّبۡهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِأَيۡدِيكُمۡ وَيُخۡزِهِمۡ وَيَنصُرۡكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَيَشۡفِ صُدُورَ قَوۡمٖ مُّؤۡمِنِينَ ١٤
9:14.t: قَٰتِلُوهُمْ يُعَذِّبْهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِأَيْدِيكُمْ وَيُخْزِهِمْ وَيَنصُرْكُمْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَيَشْفِ صُدُورَ قَوْمٍ مُّؤْمِنِينَ
9:14.tr: Qatiloohum yu'aththibhumu Allahu biaydeekum wayukhzihim wayansurkum 'alayhim wayashfi sudoora qawmin mumineen
9:14.en: Fight them; Allah will punish them by your hands and will disgrace them and give you victory over them and satisfy the breasts of a believing people
9:14.sw: Piganeni nao, Mwenyezi Mungu awaadhibu kwa mikono yenu, na awahizi na akunusuruni muwashinde, na avipoze vifua vya kaumu ya Waumini,

10:57.h: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ قَدۡ جَآءَتۡكُم مَّوۡعِظَةٞ مِّن رَّبِّكُمۡ وَشِفَآءٞ لِّمَا فِي ٱلصُّدُورِ وَهُدٗى وَرَحۡمَةٞ لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ ٥٧
10:57.t: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ قَدْ جَآءَتْكُم مَّوْعِظَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَشِفَآءٌ لِّمَا فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
10:57.tr: Ya ayyuha annasu qad jaatkum maw'ithatun min rabbikum washifaon lima fee assudoori wahudan warahmatun lilmumineen
10:57.en: O mankind, there has to come to you instruction from your Lord and healing for what is in the breasts and guidance and mercy for the believers.
10:57.sw: Enyi watu! Yamekujieni mawaidha kutoka kwa Mola wenu Mlezi, na poza kuponyesha yaliyomo vifuani, na uwongofu, na rehema kwa Waumini.

16:69.h: ثُمَّ كُلِي مِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ فَٱسۡلُكِي سُبُلَ رَبِّكِ ذُلُلٗاۚ يَخۡرُجُ مِنۢ بُطُونِهَا شَرَابٞ مُّخۡتَلِفٌ أَلۡوَٰنُهُۥ فِيهِ شِفَآءٞ لِّلنَّاسِۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ ٦٩
16:69.t: ثُمَّ كُلِى مِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ فَٱسْلُكِى سُبُلَ رَبِّكِ ذُلُلًا يَخْرُجُ مِنۢ بُطُونِهَا شَرَابٌ مُّخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَٰنُهُۥ فِيهِ شِفَآءٌ لِّلنَّاسِ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
16:69.tr: Thumma kulee min kulli aththamarati faslukee subula rabbiki thululan yakhruju min butooniha sharabun mukhtalifun alwanuhu feehi shifaon linnasi inna fee thalika laayatan liqawmin yatafakkaroon
16:69.en: Then eat from all the fruits and follow the ways of your Lord laid down [for you]." There emerges from their bellies a drink, varying in colors, in which there is healing for people. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who give thought.
16:69.sw: Kisha kula katika kila matunda, na upite katika njia za Mola wako Mlezi zilizo fanywa nyepesi kuzipita. Na kutoka matumbo yao kinatoka kinywaji chenye rangi mbali mbali; ndani yake kina matibabu kwa wanaadamu. Hakika katika haya ipo Ishara kwa watu wanao fikiri.

26:80.en: And when I am ill, it is He who cures me
26:80.sw: Na ninapo ugua ni Yeye ndiye anaye niponesha.

41:44.h: وَلَوۡ جَعَلۡنَٰهُ قُرۡءَانًا أَعۡجَمِيّٗا لَّقَالُواْ لَوۡلَا فُصِّلَتۡ ءَايَٰتُهُۥٓۖ ءَا۬عۡجَمِيّٞ وَعَرَبِيّٞۗ قُلۡ هُوَ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ هُدٗى وَشِفَآءٞۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ فِيٓ ءَاذَانِهِمۡ وَقۡرٞ وَهُوَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ عَمًىۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ يُنَادَوۡنَ مِن مَّكَانِۭ بَعِيدٖ ٤٤
41:44.t: وَلَوْ جَعَلْنَٰهُ قُرْءَانًا أَعْجَمِيًّا لَّقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا فُصِّلَتْ ءَايَٰتُهُۥٓ ءَا۬عْجَمِىٌّ وَعَرَبِىٌّ قُلْ هُوَ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ هُدًى وَشِفَآءٌ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَقْرٌ وَهُوَ عَلَيْهِمْ عَمًى أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُنَادَوْنَ مِن مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيدٍ
41:44.tr: Walaw ja'alnahu quranan a'jamiyyan laqaloo lawla fussilat ayatuhu aa'jamiyyun wa'arabiyyun qul huwa lillatheena amanoo hudan washifaon wallatheena la yuminoona fee athanihim waqrun wahuwa 'alayhim 'aman olaika yunadawna min makanin ba'eed
41:44.en: And if We had made it a non-Arabic Qur'an, they would have said, "Why are its verses not explained in detail [in our language]? Is it a foreign [recitation] and an Arab [messenger]?" Say, "It is, for those who believe, a guidance and cure." And those who do not believe - in their ears is deafness, and it is upon them blindness. Those are being called from a distant place.
41:44.sw: Na lau tungeli ifanya Qur'ani kwa lugha ya kigeni wangeli sema: Kwanini Aya zake haziku pambanuliwa? Yawaje lugha ya kigeni na Mtume Mwaarabu? Sema: Hii Qur'ani ni uwongofu na poza kwa wenye kuamini. Na wasio amini umo uziwi katika masikio yao, nayo kwao imezibwa hawaioni. Hao wanaitwa nao wako pahala mbali.

109:2.en: I do not worship what you worship.

109:3.en: Nor are you worshippers of what I worship.

109:4.en: Nor will I be a worshipper of what you worship.

109:5.en: Nor will you be worshippers of what I worship.

109:6.en: For you is your religion, and for me is my religion."
109:6.sw: Nyinyi mna dini yenu, nami nina Dini yangu.

112:1.sw: Sema: Yeye Mwenyezi Mungu ni wa pekee.

112:3.en: He neither begets nor is born,

112:4.en: Nor is there to Him any equivalent."
112:4.sw: Wala hana anaye fanana naye hata mmoja.

113:1.en: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak
113:1.sw: Sema: Najikinga kwa Mola Mlezi wa mapambazuko,

113:2.en: From the evil of that which He created

113:3.en: And from the evil of darkness when it settles
113:3.sw: Na shari ya giza la usiku liingiapo,

113:4.en: And from the evil of the blowers in knots
113:4.sw: Na shari ya wanao pulizia mafundoni,

113:5.en: And from the evil of an envier when he envies."
113:5.sw: Na shari ya hasidi anapo husudu.

114:1.en: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,
114:1.sw: Sema: Ninajikinga kwa Mola Mlezi wa wanaadamu,

114:4.en: From the evil of the retreating whisperer -
114:4.sw: Na shari ya wasiwasi wa Shetani, Khannas,

114:5.en: Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind -
114:5.sw: Anaye tia wasiwasi katika vifua vya watu,

114:6.en: From among the jinn and mankind."

4:54.h: أَمۡ يَحۡسُدُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ عَلَىٰ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ مِن فَضۡلِهِۦۖ فَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَآ ءَالَ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَٱلۡحِكۡمَةَ وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُم مُّلۡكًا عَظِيمٗا ٥٤
4:54.t: أَمْ يَحْسُدُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ عَلَىٰ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ فَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَآ ءَالَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُم مُّلْكًا عَظِيمًا
4:54.tr: Am yahsudoona annasa 'ala ma atahumu Allahu min fadlihi faqad atayna ala ibraheema alkitaba walhikmata waataynahum mulkan 'atheema
4:54.en: Or do they envy people for what Allah has given them of His bounty? But we had already given the family of Abraham the Scripture and wisdom and conferred upon them a great kingdom.
4:54.sw: Au wanawahusudu watu kwa yale aliyo wapa Mwenyezi Mungu kwa fadhila yake? Basi tuliwapa ukoo wa Ibrahim Kitabu na hikima na tukawapa utawala mkubwa.

12:5.h: قَالَ يَٰبُنَيَّ لَا تَقۡصُصۡ رُءۡيَاكَ عَلَىٰٓ إِخۡوَتِكَ فَيَكِيدُواْ لَكَ كَيۡدًاۖ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنَ لِلۡإِنسَٰنِ عَدُوّٞ مُّبِينٞ ٥
12:5.t: قَالَ يَٰبُنَىَّ لَا تَقْصُصْ رُءْيَاكَ عَلَىٰٓ إِخْوَتِكَ فَيَكِيدُوا۟ لَكَ كَيْدًا إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ لِلْإِنسَٰنِ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ
12:5.tr: Qala ya bunayya la taqsus ruyaka 'ala ikhwatika fayakeedoo laka kaydan inna ashshaytana lilinsani 'aduwwun mubeen
12:5.en: He said, "O my son, do not relate your vision to your brothers or they will contrive against you a plan. Indeed Satan, to man, is a manifest enemy.
12:5.sw: (Baba) akasema: Ewe mwanangu! Usiwasimulie nduguzo ndoto yako, wasije wakakufanyia vitimbi. Hakika Shet'ani ni adui aliye dhaahiri kwa mwanaadamu.

87:1.en: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High,
87:1.sw: Litakase jina la Mola wako Mlezi aliye juu kabisa,

96:3.en: Recite, and your Lord is the most Generous -
96:3.sw: Soma! Na Mola wako Mlezi ni Karimu kushinda wote!

57:3.h: هُوَ ٱلۡأَوَّلُ وَٱلۡأٓخِرُ وَٱلظَّٰهِرُ وَٱلۡبَاطِنُۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٌ ٣
57:3.t: هُوَ ٱلْأَوَّلُ وَٱلْـَٔاخِرُ وَٱلظَّٰهِرُ وَٱلْبَاطِنُ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
57:3.tr: Huwa alawwalu walakhiru waththahiru walbatinu wahuwa bikulli shayin 'aleem
57:3.en: He is the First and the Last, the Ascendant and the Intimate, and He is, of all things, Knowing.
57:3.sw: Yeye ndiye wa Mwanzo na ndiye wa Mwisho, naye ndiye wa Dhaahiri na wa Siri, naye ndiye Mjuzi wa kila kitu.

52:28.h: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبۡلُ نَدۡعُوهُۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ ٢٨
52:28.t: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبْلُ نَدْعُوهُ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
52:28.tr: Inna kunna min qablu nad'oohu innahu huwa albarru arraheem
52:28.en: Indeed, we used to supplicate Him before. Indeed, it is He who is the Beneficent, the Merciful."
52:28.sw: Hakika sisi zamani tulikuwa tukimwomba Yeye tu. Hakika Yeye ndiye Mwema Mwenye kurehemu.

42:11.h: فَاطِرُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنۡ أَنفُسِكُمۡ أَزۡوَٰجٗا وَمِنَ ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ أَزۡوَٰجٗا يَذۡرَؤُكُمۡ فِيهِۚ لَيۡسَ كَمِثۡلِهِۦ شَيۡءٞۖ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡبَصِيرُ ١١
42:11.t: فَاطِرُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا وَمِنَ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ أَزْوَٰجًا يَذْرَؤُكُمْ فِيهِ لَيْسَ كَمِثْلِهِۦ شَىْءٌ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْبَصِيرُ
42:11.tr: Fatiru assamawati walardi ja'ala lakum min anfusikum azwajan wamina alan'ami azwajan yathraokum feehi laysa kamithlihi shayon wahuwa assamee'u albaseer
42:11.en: [He is] Creator of the heavens and the earth. He has made for you from yourselves, mates, and among the cattle, mates; He multiplies you thereby. There is nothing like unto Him, and He is the Hearing, the Seeing.
42:11.sw: Yeye ndiye Muumba mbingu na ardhi, amekujaalieni mke na mume katika nafsi zenu, na katika nyama hoa dume na jike, anakuzidishieni namna hii. Hapana kitu kama mfano wake. Naye ni Mwenye kusikia Mwenye kuona.

2:37.h: فَتَلَقَّىٰٓ ءَادَمُ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ كَلِمَٰتٖ فَتَابَ عَلَيۡهِۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ ٣٧
2:37.t: فَتَلَقَّىٰٓ ءَادَمُ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ كَلِمَٰتٍ فَتَابَ عَلَيْهِ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
2:37.tr: Fatalaqqa adamu min rabbihi kalimatin fataba 'alayhi innahu huwa attawwabu arraheem
2:37.en: Then Adam received from his Lord [some] words, and He accepted his repentance. Indeed, it is He who is the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful.
2:37.sw: Kisha Adam akapokea maneno kwa Mola wake Mlezi, na Mola wake Mlezi alimkubalia toba yake; hakika Yeye ndiye Mwingi wa kukubali toba na Mwenye kurehemu.

12:64.h: قَالَ هَلۡ ءَامَنُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ إِلَّا كَمَآ أَمِنتُكُمۡ عَلَىٰٓ أَخِيهِ مِن قَبۡلُ فَٱللَّهُ خَيۡرٌ حَٰفِظٗاۖ وَهُوَ أَرۡحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ ٦٤
12:64.t: قَالَ هَلْ ءَامَنُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا كَمَآ أَمِنتُكُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَخِيهِ مِن قَبْلُ فَٱللَّهُ خَيْرٌ حَٰفِظًا وَهُوَ أَرْحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
12:64.tr: Qala hal amanukum 'alayhi illa kama amintukum 'ala akheehi min qablu fallahu khayrun hafithan wahuwa arhamu arrahimeen
12:64.en: He said, "Should I entrust you with him except [under coercion] as I entrusted you with his brother before? But Allah is the best guardian, and He is the most merciful of the merciful."
12:64.sw: Je, nikuaminini kwa huyu ila kama nilivyo kuaminini kwa nduguye zamani? Lakini Mwenyezi Mungu ndiye Mbora wa kulinda, naye ndiye Mbora wa kurehemu kuliko wenye kurehemu wote.

4:6.h: وَٱبۡتَلُواْ ٱلۡيَتَٰمَىٰ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغُواْ ٱلنِّكَاحَ فَإِنۡ ءَانَسۡتُم مِّنۡهُمۡ رُشۡدٗا فَٱدۡفَعُوٓاْ إِلَيۡهِمۡ أَمۡوَٰلَهُمۡۖ وَلَا تَأۡكُلُوهَآ إِسۡرَافٗا وَبِدَارًا أَن يَكۡبَرُواْۚ وَمَن كَانَ غَنِيّٗا فَلۡيَسۡتَعۡفِفۡۖ وَمَن كَانَ فَقِيرٗا فَلۡيَأۡكُلۡ بِٱلۡمَعۡرُوفِۚ فَإِذَا دَفَعۡتُمۡ إِلَيۡهِمۡ أَمۡوَٰلَهُمۡ فَأَشۡهِدُواْ عَلَيۡهِمۡۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ حَسِيبٗا ٦
4:6.t: وَٱبْتَلُوا۟ ٱلْيَتَٰمَىٰ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغُوا۟ ٱلنِّكَاحَ فَإِنْ ءَانَسْتُم مِّنْهُمْ رُشْدًا فَٱدْفَعُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِمْ أَمْوَٰلَهُمْ وَلَا تَأْكُلُوهَآ إِسْرَافًا وَبِدَارًا أَن يَكْبَرُوا۟ وَمَن كَانَ غَنِيًّا فَلْيَسْتَعْفِفْ وَمَن كَانَ فَقِيرًا فَلْيَأْكُلْ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ فَإِذَا دَفَعْتُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ أَمْوَٰلَهُمْ فَأَشْهِدُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ حَسِيبًا
4:6.tr: Wabtaloo alyatama hatta itha balaghoo annikaha fain anastum minhum rushdan fadfa'oo ilayhim amwalahum wala takulooha israfan wabidaran an yakbaroo waman kana ghaniyyan falyasta'fif waman kana faqeeran falyakul bilma'roofi faitha dafa'tum ilayhim amwalahum faashhidoo 'alayhim wakafa billahi haseeba
4:6.en: And test the orphans [in their abilities] until they reach marriageable age. Then if you perceive in them sound judgement, release their property to them. And do not consume it excessively and quickly, [anticipating] that they will grow up. And whoever, [when acting as guardian], is self-sufficient should refrain [from taking a fee]; and whoever is poor - let him take according to what is acceptable. Then when you release their property to them, bring witnesses upon them. And sufficient is Allah as Accountant.
4:6.sw: Na wajaribuni mayatima mpaka wafike umri wa kuoa. Mkiwaona ni wekevu, basi wapeni mali yao. Wala msiyale kwa fujo na pupa kwa kuwa watakuja kuwa watu wazima. Na aliye kuwa tajiri naajizuilie, na aliye fakiri basi naale kwa kadri ya ada. Na mtakapo wapa mali yao washuhudizieni. Na Mwenyezi Mungu anatosha kuwa Mhasibu.

11:57.h: فَإِن تَوَلَّوۡاْ فَقَدۡ أَبۡلَغۡتُكُم مَّآ أُرۡسِلۡتُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَيۡكُمۡۚ وَيَسۡتَخۡلِفُ رَبِّي قَوۡمًا غَيۡرَكُمۡ وَلَا تَضُرُّونَهُۥ شَيۡـًٔاۚ إِنَّ رَبِّي عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ حَفِيظٞ ٥٧
11:57.t: فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَقَدْ أَبْلَغْتُكُم مَّآ أُرْسِلْتُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَيْكُمْ وَيَسْتَخْلِفُ رَبِّى قَوْمًا غَيْرَكُمْ وَلَا تَضُرُّونَهُۥ شَيْـًٔا إِنَّ رَبِّى عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ حَفِيظٌ
11:57.tr: Fain tawallaw faqad ablaghtukum ma orsiltu bihi ilaykum wayastakhlifu rabbee qawman ghayrakum wala tadurroonahu shayan inna rabbee 'ala kulli shayin hafeeth
11:57.en: But if they turn away, [say], "I have already conveyed that with which I was sent to you. My Lord will give succession to a people other than you, and you will not harm Him at all. Indeed my Lord is, over all things, Guardian."
11:57.sw: Na ikiwa watarudi nyuma, basi mimi nimekwisha kufikishieni niliyo tumwa kwenu. Na Mola wangu Mlezi atawaleta watu wengine badala yenu, wala nyinyi hamumdhuru kitu Yeye. Hakika Mola wangu Mlezi ni Mwenye kuhifadhi kila kitu.

19:47.h: قَالَ سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيۡكَۖ سَأَسۡتَغۡفِرُ لَكَ رَبِّيٓۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِي حَفِيّٗا ٤٧
19:47.t: قَالَ سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْكَ سَأَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكَ رَبِّىٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِى حَفِيًّا
19:47.tr: Qala salamun 'alayka saastaghfiru laka rabbee innahu kana bee hafiyya
19:47.en: [Abraham] said, "Peace will be upon you. I will ask forgiveness for you of my Lord. Indeed, He is ever gracious to me.
19:47.sw: (Ibrahim) akasema: Salamun a'laika! Amani iwe juu yako! Mimi nitakuombea msamaha kwa Mola wangu Mlezi. Hakika Yeye ananihurumia sana.

24:25.h: يَوۡمَئِذٖ يُوَفِّيهِمُ ٱللَّهُ دِينَهُمُ ٱلۡحَقَّ وَيَعۡلَمُونَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلۡحَقُّ ٱلۡمُبِينُ ٢٥
24:25.t: يَوْمَئِذٍ يُوَفِّيهِمُ ٱللَّهُ دِينَهُمُ ٱلْحَقَّ وَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ ٱلْمُبِينُ
24:25.tr: Yawmaithin yuwaffeehimu Allahu deenahumu alhaqqa waya'lamoona anna Allaha huwa alhaqqu almubeen
24:25.en: That Day, Allah will pay them in full their deserved recompense, and they will know that it is Allah who is the perfect in justice.
24:25.sw: Siku hiyo Mwenyezi Mungu atawapa sawa sawa malipo yao ya haki, na watajua kwamba hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ndiye Haki Iliyo Wazi.

2:32.h: قَالُواْ سُبۡحَٰنَكَ لَا عِلۡمَ لَنَآ إِلَّا مَا عَلَّمۡتَنَآۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ ٣٢
2:32.t: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَٰنَكَ لَا عِلْمَ لَنَآ إِلَّا مَا عَلَّمْتَنَآ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
2:32.tr: Qaloo subhanaka la 'ilma lana illa ma 'allamtana innaka anta al'aleemu alhakeem
2:32.en: They said, "Exalted are You; we have no knowledge except what You have taught us. Indeed, it is You who is the Knowing, the Wise."
2:32.sw: Wakasema: Subhanaka, Wewe umetakasika! Hatuna ujuzi isipokuwa kwa uliyo tufunza Wewe. Hakika Wewe ndiye Mjuzi Mwenye hikima.

2:225.h: لَّا يُؤَاخِذُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِٱللَّغۡوِ فِيٓ أَيۡمَٰنِكُمۡ وَلَٰكِن يُؤَاخِذُكُم بِمَا كَسَبَتۡ قُلُوبُكُمۡۗ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ حَلِيمٞ ٢٢٥
2:225.t: لَّا يُؤَاخِذُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِٱللَّغْوِ فِىٓ أَيْمَٰنِكُمْ وَلَٰكِن يُؤَاخِذُكُم بِمَا كَسَبَتْ قُلُوبُكُمْ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ حَلِيمٌ
2:225.tr: La yuakhithukumu Allahu billaghwi fee aymanikum walakin yuakhithukum bima kasabat quloobukum wallahu ghafoorun haleem
2:225.en: Allah does not impose blame upon you for what is unintentional in your oaths, but He imposes blame upon you for what your hearts have earned. And Allah is Forgiving and Forbearing.
2:225.sw: Mwenyezi Mungu hakushikeni kwa viapo vyenu vya upuuzi. Bali anakushikeni kwa yanayo chuma nyoyo zenu. Na Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mwenye kusamehe na Mpole.

35:15.h: ۞ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ أَنتُمُ ٱلۡفُقَرَآءُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِۖ وَٱللَّهُ هُوَ ٱلۡغَنِيُّ ٱلۡحَمِيدُ ١٥
35:15.t: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ أَنتُمُ ٱلْفُقَرَآءُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ هُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ
35:15.tr: Ya ayyuha annasu antumu alfuqarao ila Allahi wallahu huwa alghaniyyu alhameed
35:15.en: O mankind, you are those in need of Allah, while Allah is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.
35:15.sw: Enyi watu! Nyinyi ndio wenye haja kwa Mwenyezi Mungu, na Mwenyezi Mungu ndiye Mwenye kujitosha, Msifiwa.

6:18.h: وَهُوَ ٱلۡقَاهِرُ فَوۡقَ عِبَادِهِۦۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ ٱلۡخَبِيرُ ١٨
6:18.t: وَهُوَ ٱلْقَاهِرُ فَوْقَ عِبَادِهِۦ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
6:18.tr: Wahuwa alqahiru fawqa 'ibadihi wahuwa alhakeemu alkhabeer
6:18.en: And He is the subjugator over His servants. And He is the Wise, the Acquainted [with all].
6:18.sw: Naye ndiye Mwenye nguvu juu ya waja wake, na ndiye Mwenye hikima na Mwenye khabari zote.

15:86.en: Indeed, your Lord - He is the Knowing Creator.
15:86.sw: Hakika Mola wako Mlezi ndiye Muumbaji Mjuzi.

2:143.h: وَكَذَٰلِكَ جَعَلۡنَٰكُمۡ أُمَّةٗ وَسَطٗا لِّتَكُونُواْ شُهَدَآءَ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ وَيَكُونَ ٱلرَّسُولُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ شَهِيدٗاۗ وَمَا جَعَلۡنَا ٱلۡقِبۡلَةَ ٱلَّتِي كُنتَ عَلَيۡهَآ إِلَّا لِنَعۡلَمَ مَن يَتَّبِعُ ٱلرَّسُولَ مِمَّن يَنقَلِبُ عَلَىٰ عَقِبَيۡهِۚ وَإِن كَانَتۡ لَكَبِيرَةً إِلَّا عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ هَدَى ٱللَّهُۗ وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيُضِيعَ إِيمَٰنَكُمۡۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِٱلنَّاسِ لَرَءُوفٞ رَّحِيمٞ ١٤٣
2:143.t: وَكَذَٰلِكَ جَعَلْنَٰكُمْ أُمَّةً وَسَطًا لِّتَكُونُوا۟ شُهَدَآءَ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ وَيَكُونَ ٱلرَّسُولُ عَلَيْكُمْ شَهِيدًا وَمَا جَعَلْنَا ٱلْقِبْلَةَ ٱلَّتِى كُنتَ عَلَيْهَآ إِلَّا لِنَعْلَمَ مَن يَتَّبِعُ ٱلرَّسُولَ مِمَّن يَنقَلِبُ عَلَىٰ عَقِبَيْهِ وَإِن كَانَتْ لَكَبِيرَةً إِلَّا عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ هَدَى ٱللَّهُ وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيُضِيعَ إِيمَٰنَكُمْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِٱلنَّاسِ لَرَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
2:143.tr: Wakathalika ja'alnakum ommatan wasatan litakoonoo shuhadaa 'ala annasi wayakoona arrasoolu 'alaykum shaheedan wama ja'alna alqiblata allatee kunta 'alayha illa lina'lama man yattabi'u arrasoola mimman yanqalibu 'ala 'aqibayhi wain kanat lakabeeratan illa 'ala allatheena hada Allahu wama kana Allahu liyudee'a eemanakum inna Allaha binnasi laraoofun raheem
2:143.en: And thus we have made you a just community that you will be witnesses over the people and the Messenger will be a witness over you. And We did not make the qiblah which you used to face except that We might make evident who would follow the Messenger from who would turn back on his heels. And indeed, it is difficult except for those whom Allah has guided. And never would Allah have caused you to lose your faith. Indeed Allah is, to the people, Kind and Merciful.
2:143.sw: Na vivyo hivyo tumekufanyeni muwe Umma wa wasitani, ili muwe mashahidi juu ya watu, na Mtume awe ni shahidi juu yenu. Na hatukukifanya kibla ulicho kuwa nacho ila tupate kumjua yule anaye mfuata Mtume na yule anaye geuka akarejea nyuma. Na kwa yakini hilo lilikuwa jambo gumu isipo kuwa kwa wale alio waongoa Mwenyezi Mungu. Na Mwenyezi Mungu hakuwa mwenye kuipoteza Imani yenu. Kwani Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mpole kwa watu na Mwenye kuwarehemu.

51:58.h: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلۡقُوَّةِ ٱلۡمَتِينُ ٥٨
51:58.t: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلْقُوَّةِ ٱلْمَتِينُ
51:58.tr: Inna Allaha huwa arrazzaqu thoo alquwwati almateen
51:58.en: Indeed, it is Allah who is the [continual] Provider, the firm possessor of strength.
51:58.sw: Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ndiye Mwenye kuruzuku, Mwenye nguvu, Madhubuti.

4:1.h: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱتَّقُواْ رَبَّكُمُ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَكُم مِّن نَّفۡسٖ وَٰحِدَةٖ وَخَلَقَ مِنۡهَا زَوۡجَهَا وَبَثَّ مِنۡهُمَا رِجَالٗا كَثِيرٗا وَنِسَآءٗۚ وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِي تَسَآءَلُونَ بِهِۦ وَٱلۡأَرۡحَامَۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ رَقِيبٗا ١
4:1.t: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱتَّقُوا۟ رَبَّكُمُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُم مِّن نَّفْسٍ وَٰحِدَةٍ وَخَلَقَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا وَبَثَّ مِنْهُمَا رِجَالًا كَثِيرًا وَنِسَآءً وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِى تَسَآءَلُونَ بِهِۦ وَٱلْأَرْحَامَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلَيْكُمْ رَقِيبًا
4:1.tr: Ya ayyuha annasu ittaqoo rabbakumu allathee khalaqakum min nafsin wahidatin wakhalaqa minha zawjaha wabaththa minhuma rijalan katheeran wanisaan wattaqoo Allaha allathee tasaaloona bihi walarhama inna Allaha kana 'alaykum raqeeb
4:1.en: O mankind, fear your Lord, who created you from one soul and created from it its mate and dispersed from both of them many men and women. And fear Allah, through whom you ask one another, and the wombs. Indeed Allah is ever, over you, an Observer.
4:1.sw: Enyi watu! Mcheni Mola wenu Mlezi aliye kuumbeni kutokana na nafsi moja, na akamuumba mkewe kutoka nafsi ile ile. Na akaeneza kutokana na wawili hao wanaume na wanawake wengi. Na tahadharini na Mwenyezi Mungu ambaye kwaye mnaombana, na jamaa zenu. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mwenye kuwaangalieni.

2:158.h: ۞ إِنَّ ٱلصَّفَا وَٱلۡمَرۡوَةَ مِن شَعَآئِرِ ٱللَّهِۖ فَمَنۡ حَجَّ ٱلۡبَيۡتَ أَوِ ٱعۡتَمَرَ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيۡهِ أَن يَطَّوَّفَ بِهِمَاۚ وَمَن تَطَوَّعَ خَيۡرٗا فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ شَاكِرٌ عَلِيمٌ ١٥٨
2:158.t: إِنَّ ٱلصَّفَا وَٱلْمَرْوَةَ مِن شَعَآئِرِ ٱللَّهِ فَمَنْ حَجَّ ٱلْبَيْتَ أَوِ ٱعْتَمَرَ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِ أَن يَطَّوَّفَ بِهِمَا وَمَن تَطَوَّعَ خَيْرًا فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ شَاكِرٌ عَلِيمٌ
2:158.tr: Inna assafa walmarwata min sha'airi Allahi faman hajja albayta awi i'tamara fala junaha 'alayhi an yattawwafa bihima waman tatawwa'a khayran fainna Allaha shakirun 'aleem
2:158.en: Indeed, as-Safa and al-Marwah are among the symbols of Allah. So whoever makes Hajj to the House or performs 'umrah - there is no blame upon him for walking between them. And whoever volunteers good - then indeed, Allah is appreciative and Knowing.
2:158.sw: Hakika vilima vya Safaa na Marwa ni katika alama za Mwenyezi Mungu. Basi anaye hiji kwenye Nyumba hiyo au akafanya Umra, si kosa kwake kuvizunguka. Na anaye jitendea mwenyewe kheri basi bila ya shaka Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mwenye shukrani na Mjuzi.

35:34.h: وَقَالُواْ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَذۡهَبَ عَنَّا ٱلۡحَزَنَۖ إِنَّ رَبَّنَا لَغَفُورٞ شَكُورٌ ٣٤
35:34.t: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَذْهَبَ عَنَّا ٱلْحَزَنَ إِنَّ رَبَّنَا لَغَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ
35:34.tr: Waqaloo alhamdu lillahi allathee athhaba 'anna alhazana inna rabbana laghafoorun shakoor
35:34.en: And they will say, "Praise to Allah, who has removed from us [all] sorrow. Indeed, our Lord is Forgiving and Appreciative -
35:34.sw: Na watasema: Alhamdulillahi, Sifa njema zote ni za Mwenyezi Mungu aliye tuondolea huzuni zote. Hakika Mola wetu Mlezi bila ya shaka ni Mwenye kusamehe, Mwenye shukrani.

22:17.h: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَٱلَّذِينَ هَادُواْ وَٱلصَّٰبِـِٔينَ وَٱلنَّصَٰرَىٰ وَٱلۡمَجُوسَ وَٱلَّذِينَ أَشۡرَكُوٓاْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَفۡصِلُ بَيۡنَهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ شَهِيدٌ ١٧
22:17.t: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱلَّذِينَ هَادُوا۟ وَٱلصَّٰبِـِٔينَ وَٱلنَّصَٰرَىٰ وَٱلْمَجُوسَ وَٱلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
22:17.tr: Inna allatheena amanoo wallatheena hadoo wassabieena wannasara walmajoosa wallatheena ashrakoo inna Allaha yafsilu baynahum yawma alqiyamati inna Allaha 'ala kulli shayin shaheed
22:17.en: Indeed, those who have believed and those who were Jews and the Sabeans and the Christians and the Magians and those who associated with Allah - Allah will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed Allah is, over all things, Witness.
22:17.sw: Hakika walio amini, na ambao ni Mayahudi na Wasabai na Wakristo na Majusi na wale walio shiriki - hakika Mwenyezi Mungu atawapambanua baina yao Siku ya Kiyama. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ni Shahidi wa kila kitu.

4:43.h: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تَقۡرَبُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَأَنتُمۡ سُكَٰرَىٰ حَتَّىٰ تَعۡلَمُواْ مَا تَقُولُونَ وَلَا جُنُبًا إِلَّا عَابِرِي سَبِيلٍ حَتَّىٰ تَغۡتَسِلُواْۚ وَإِن كُنتُم مَّرۡضَىٰٓ أَوۡ عَلَىٰ سَفَرٍ أَوۡ جَآءَ أَحَدٞ مِّنكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡغَآئِطِ أَوۡ لَٰمَسۡتُمُ ٱلنِّسَآءَ فَلَمۡ تَجِدُواْ مَآءٗ فَتَيَمَّمُواْ صَعِيدٗا طَيِّبٗا فَٱمۡسَحُواْ بِوُجُوهِكُمۡ وَأَيۡدِيكُمۡۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَفُوًّا غَفُورًا ٤٣
4:43.t: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَقْرَبُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَأَنتُمْ سُكَٰرَىٰ حَتَّىٰ تَعْلَمُوا۟ مَا تَقُولُونَ وَلَا جُنُبًا إِلَّا عَابِرِى سَبِيلٍ حَتَّىٰ تَغْتَسِلُوا۟ وَإِن كُنتُم مَّرْضَىٰٓ أَوْ عَلَىٰ سَفَرٍ أَوْ جَآءَ أَحَدٌ مِّنكُم مِّنَ ٱلْغَآئِطِ أَوْ لَٰمَسْتُمُ ٱلنِّسَآءَ فَلَمْ تَجِدُوا۟ مَآءً فَتَيَمَّمُوا۟ صَعِيدًا طَيِّبًا فَٱمْسَحُوا۟ بِوُجُوهِكُمْ وَأَيْدِيكُمْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَفُوًّا غَفُورًا
4:43.tr: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la taqraboo assalata waantum sukara hatta ta'lamoo ma taqooloona wala junuban illa 'abiree sabeelin hatta taghtasiloo wain kuntum marda aw 'ala safarin aw jaa ahadun minkum mina alghaiti aw lamastumu annisaa falam tajidoo maan fatayammamoo sa'eedan tayyiban famsahoo biwujoohikum waaydeekum inna Allaha kana 'afuwwan ghafoora
4:43.en: O you who have believed, do not approach prayer while you are intoxicated until you know what you are saying or in a state of janabah, except those passing through [a place of prayer], until you have washed [your whole body]. And if you are ill or on a journey or one of you comes from the place of relieving himself or you have contacted women and find no water, then seek clean earth and wipe over your faces and your hands [with it]. Indeed, Allah is ever Pardoning and Forgiving.
4:43.sw: Enyi mlio amini! Msikaribie Sala, hali mmelewa, mpaka myajue mnayo yasema, wala hali mna janaba - isipo kuwa mmo safarini - mpaka mkoge. Na mkiwa wagonjwa, au mmo safarini, au mmoja wenu ametoka chooni, au mmewagusa wanawake - na msipate maji, basi ukusudieni mchanga safi, mpake nyuso zenu na mikono yenu. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ni Msamehevu na Mwenye kughufiria.

71:10.h: فَقُلۡتُ ٱسۡتَغۡفِرُواْ رَبَّكُمۡ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارٗا ١٠
71:10.t: فَقُلْتُ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارًا
71:10.tr: Faqultu istaghfiroo rabbakum innahu kana ghaffara
71:10.en: And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver.
71:10.sw: Nikasema: Ombeni msamaha kwa Mola wenu Mlezi; hakika Yeye ni Mwingi wa kusamehe.

15:49.h: ۞ نَبِّئۡ عِبَادِيٓ أَنِّيٓ أَنَا ٱلۡغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ ٤٩
15:49.t: نَبِّئْ عِبَادِىٓ أَنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
15:49.en: [O Muhammad], inform My servants that it is I who am the Forgiving, the Merciful.
15:49.sw: Waambie waja wangu ya kwamba Mimi ndiye Mwenye kusamehe, Mwenye kurehemu.

34:26.h: قُلۡ يَجۡمَعُ بَيۡنَنَا رَبُّنَا ثُمَّ يَفۡتَحُ بَيۡنَنَا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَهُوَ ٱلۡفَتَّاحُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ ٢٦
34:26.t: قُلْ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَنَا رَبُّنَا ثُمَّ يَفْتَحُ بَيْنَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَهُوَ ٱلْفَتَّاحُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
34:26.tr: Qul yajma'u baynana rabbuna thumma yaftahu baynana bilhaqqi wahuwa alfattahu al'aleem
34:26.en: Say, "Our Lord will bring us together; then He will judge between us in truth. And He is the Knowing Judge."
34:26.sw: Sema: Mola wetu Mlezi atatukusanya, kisha atatuhukumu kwa haki; na Yeye ndiye Hakimu Mwenye kujua.

6:65.h: قُلۡ هُوَ ٱلۡقَادِرُ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَبۡعَثَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ عَذَابٗا مِّن فَوۡقِكُمۡ أَوۡ مِن تَحۡتِ أَرۡجُلِكُمۡ أَوۡ يَلۡبِسَكُمۡ شِيَعٗا وَيُذِيقَ بَعۡضَكُم بَأۡسَ بَعۡضٍۗ ٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ نُصَرِّفُ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَفۡقَهُونَ ٦٥
6:65.t: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلْقَادِرُ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَبْعَثَ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابًا مِّن فَوْقِكُمْ أَوْ مِن تَحْتِ أَرْجُلِكُمْ أَوْ يَلْبِسَكُمْ شِيَعًا وَيُذِيقَ بَعْضَكُم بَأْسَ بَعْضٍ ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ نُصَرِّفُ ٱلْـَٔايَٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَفْقَهُونَ
6:65.tr: Qul huwa alqadiru 'ala an yab'atha 'alaykum 'athaban min fawqikum aw min tahti arjulikum aw yalbisakum shiya'an wayutheeqa ba'dakum basa ba'din onthur kayfa nusarrifu alayati la'allahum yafqahoon
6:65.en: Say, "He is the [one] Able to send upon you affliction from above you or from beneath your feet or to confuse you [so you become] sects and make you taste the violence of one another." Look how We diversify the signs that they might understand.
6:65.sw: Sema: Yeye ndiye Muweza wa kukuleteeni adhabu kutoka juu yenu au kutoka chini ya miguu yenu, au kukuleteeni fujo la mfarakano, na kuwaonjesha baadhi yenu jeuri ya wenzao. Tazama vipi tunavyo zieleza Aya ili wapate kufahamu.

30:54.h: ۞ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَكُم مِّن ضَعۡفٖ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ ضَعۡفٖ قُوَّةٗ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ قُوَّةٖ ضَعۡفٗا وَشَيۡبَةٗۚ يَخۡلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ ٱلۡقَدِيرُ ٥٤
30:54.t: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُم مِّن ضَعْفٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ضَعْفٍ قُوَّةً ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ قُوَّةٍ ضَعْفًا وَشَيْبَةً يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْقَدِيرُ
30:54.tr: Allahu allathee khalaqakum min da'fin thumma ja'ala min ba'di da'fin quwwatan thumma ja'ala min ba'di quwwatin da'fan washaybatan yakhluqu ma yashao wahuwa al'aleemu alqadeer
30:54.en: Allah is the one who created you from weakness, then made after weakness strength, then made after strength weakness and white hair. He creates what He wills, and He is the Knowing, the Competent.
30:54.sw: Mwenyezi Mungu ndiye aliye kuumbeni kutokana na udhaifu kisha akajaalia nguvu baada ya unyonge, kisha akajaalia baada ya nguvu unyonge tena na ukongwe. Anaumba atakavyo. Naye ndiye Mjuzi, Mwenye uweza.

2:186.h: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌۖ أُجِيبُ دَعۡوَةَ ٱلدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِۖ فَلۡيَسۡتَجِيبُواْ لِي وَلۡيُؤۡمِنُواْ بِي لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡشُدُونَ ١٨٦
2:186.t: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِى عَنِّى فَإِنِّى قَرِيبٌ أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ ٱلدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِ فَلْيَسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لِى وَلْيُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِى لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْشُدُونَ
2:186.tr: Waitha saalaka 'ibadee 'annee fainnee qareebun ojeebu da'wata adda'i itha da'ani falyastajeeboo lee walyuminoo bee la'allahum yarshudoon
2:186.en: And when My servants ask you, [O Muhammad], concerning Me - indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the supplicant when he calls upon Me. So let them respond to Me [by obedience] and believe in Me that they may be [rightly] guided.
2:186.sw: Na waja wangu watakapo kuuliza khabari zangu, waambie kuwa Mimi nipo karibu. Naitikia maombi ya mwombaji anapo niomba. Basi na waniitikie Mimi, na waniamini Mimi, ili wapate kuongoka.

42:19.h: ٱللَّهُ لَطِيفُۢ بِعِبَادِهِۦ يَرۡزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُۖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡقَوِيُّ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ١٩
42:19.t: ٱللَّهُ لَطِيفٌۢ بِعِبَادِهِۦ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَهُوَ ٱلْقَوِىُّ ٱلْعَزِيزُ
42:19.tr: Allahu lateefun bi'ibadihi yarzuqu man yashao wahuwa alqawiyyu al'azeez
42:19.en: Allah is Subtle with His servants; He gives provisions to whom He wills. And He is the Powerful, the Exalted in Might.
42:19.sw: Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mpole kwa waja wake. Humruzuku ampendaye. Naye ni Mwenye nguvu, Mtukufu.

13:16.h: قُلۡ مَن رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ قُلِ ٱللَّهُۚ قُلۡ أَفَٱتَّخَذۡتُم مِّن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوۡلِيَآءَ لَا يَمۡلِكُونَ لِأَنفُسِهِمۡ نَفۡعٗا وَلَا ضَرّٗاۚ قُلۡ هَلۡ يَسۡتَوِي ٱلۡأَعۡمَىٰ وَٱلۡبَصِيرُ أَمۡ هَلۡ تَسۡتَوِي ٱلظُّلُمَٰتُ وَٱلنُّورُۗ أَمۡ جَعَلُواْ لِلَّهِ شُرَكَآءَ خَلَقُواْ كَخَلۡقِهِۦ فَتَشَٰبَهَ ٱلۡخَلۡقُ عَلَيۡهِمۡۚ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ خَٰلِقُ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡوَٰحِدُ ٱلۡقَهَّٰرُ ١٦
13:16.t: قُلْ مَن رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ قُلْ أَفَٱتَّخَذْتُم مِّن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ لِأَنفُسِهِمْ نَفْعًا وَلَا ضَرًّا قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِى ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ وَٱلْبَصِيرُ أَمْ هَلْ تَسْتَوِى ٱلظُّلُمَٰتُ وَٱلنُّورُ أَمْ جَعَلُوا۟ لِلَّهِ شُرَكَآءَ خَلَقُوا۟ كَخَلْقِهِۦ فَتَشَٰبَهَ ٱلْخَلْقُ عَلَيْهِمْ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ خَٰلِقُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَهُوَ ٱلْوَٰحِدُ ٱلْقَهَّٰرُ
13:16.tr: Qul man rabbu assamawati walardi quli Allahu qul afattakhathtum min doonihi awliyaa la yamlikoona lianfusihim naf'an wala darran qul hal yastawee ala'ma walbaseeru am hal tastawee aththulumatu wannooru am ja'aloo lillahi shurakaa khalaqoo kakhalqihi fatashabaha alkhalqu 'alayhim quli Allahu khaliqu kulli shayin wahuwa alwahidu alqahhar
13:16.en: Say, "Who is Lord of the heavens and earth?" Say, "Allah." Say, "Have you then taken besides Him allies not possessing [even] for themselves any benefit or any harm?" Say, "Is the blind equivalent to the seeing? Or is darkness equivalent to light? Or have they attributed to Allah partners who created like His creation so that the creation [of each] seemed similar to them?" Say, "Allah is the Creator of all things, and He is the One, the Prevailing."
13:16.sw: Sema: Ni nani Mola Mlezi wa mbingu na ardhi? Sema: Mwenyezi Mungu. Sema: Basi je, mnawafanya wenginewe badala yake kuwa ni walinzi, nao hawajifai wenyewe kwa jema wala baya? Sema: Hebu kipofu na mwenye kuona huwa sawa? Au hebu huwa sawa giza na mwangaza? Au wamemfanyia Mwenyezi Mungu washirika walio umba kama alivyo umba Yeye, na viumbe hivyo vikawadanganyikia? Sema: Mwenyezi Mungu ndiye Muumba wa kila kitu. Na Yeye ni Mmoja Mwenye kushinda!

13:9.en: [He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Grand, the Exalted.
13:9.sw: Yeye ndiye Mwenye kujua yanayo onekana na yasio onekana; Mkuu Aliye tukuka.

82:6.h: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلۡكَرِيمِ ٦
82:6.t: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
82:6.tr: Ya ayyuha alinsanu ma gharraka birabbika alkareem
82:6.en: O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous,
82:6.sw: Ewe mwanaadamu! Nini kilicho kughuri ukamwacha Mola wako Mlezi Mtukufu?

67:14.h: أَلَا يَعۡلَمُ مَنۡ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلۡخَبِيرُ ١٤
67:14.t: أَلَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
67:14.tr: Ala ya'lamu man khalaqa wahuwa allateefu alkhabeer
67:14.en: Does He who created not know, while He is the Subtle, the Acquainted?
67:14.sw: Asijue aliye umba, naye ndiye Mjua siri, Mwenye khabari?

11:61.h: ۞ وَإِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمۡ صَٰلِحٗاۚ قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ ٱعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنۡ إِلَٰهٍ غَيۡرُهُۥۖ هُوَ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَٱسۡتَعۡمَرَكُمۡ فِيهَا فَٱسۡتَغۡفِرُوهُ ثُمَّ تُوبُوٓاْ إِلَيۡهِۚ إِنَّ رَبِّي قَرِيبٞ مُّجِيبٞ ٦١
11:61.t: وَإِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَٰلِحًا قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥ هُوَ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱسْتَعْمَرَكُمْ فِيهَا فَٱسْتَغْفِرُوهُ ثُمَّ تُوبُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ إِنَّ رَبِّى قَرِيبٌ مُّجِيبٌ
11:61.tr: Waila thamooda akhahum salihan qala ya qawmi o'budoo Allaha ma lakum min ilahin ghayruhu huwa anshaakum mina alardi wasta'marakum feeha fastaghfiroohu thumma tooboo ilayhi inna rabbee qareebun mujeeb
11:61.en: And to Thamud [We sent] their brother Salih. He said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him. He has produced you from the earth and settled you in it, so ask forgiveness of Him and then repent to Him. Indeed, my Lord is near and responsive."
11:61.sw: Na kina Thamud tuliwapelekea ndugu yao Saleh. Akasema: Enyi watu wangu! Muabuduni Mwenyezi Mungu. Nyinyi hamna Mungu ila Yeye. Yeye ndiye aliye kuumbeni katika ardhi, na akakuwekeni humo. Basi mwombeni msamaha, kisha mtubu kwake. Hakika Mola wangu Mlezi yupo karibu, anaitikia maombi.

11:73.h: قَالُوٓاْ أَتَعۡجَبِينَ مِنۡ أَمۡرِ ٱللَّهِۖ رَحۡمَتُ ٱللَّهِ وَبَرَكَٰتُهُۥ عَلَيۡكُمۡ أَهۡلَ ٱلۡبَيۡتِۚ إِنَّهُۥ حَمِيدٞ مَّجِيدٞ ٧٣
11:73.t: قَالُوٓا۟ أَتَعْجَبِينَ مِنْ أَمْرِ ٱللَّهِ رَحْمَتُ ٱللَّهِ وَبَرَكَٰتُهُۥ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ ٱلْبَيْتِ إِنَّهُۥ حَمِيدٌ مَّجِيدٌ
11:73.tr: Qaloo ata'jabeena min amri Allahi rahmatu Allahi wabarakatuhu 'alaykum ahla albayti innahu hameedun majeed
11:73.en: They said, "Are you amazed at the decree of Allah? May the mercy of Allah and His blessings be upon you, people of the house. Indeed, He is Praiseworthy and Honorable."
11:73.sw: Wakasema: Je, unastaajabia amri ya Mwenyezi Mungu? Rehema ya Mwenyezi Mungu na baraka zake ziko juu yenu, enyi watu wa nyumba hii! Hakika Yeye ndiye Msifiwa wa kutukuzwa.

41:54.h: أَلَآ إِنَّهُمۡ فِي مِرۡيَةٖ مِّن لِّقَآءِ رَبِّهِمۡۗ أَلَآ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٖ مُّحِيطُۢ ٥٤
41:54.t: أَلَآ إِنَّهُمْ فِى مِرْيَةٍ مِّن لِّقَآءِ رَبِّهِمْ أَلَآ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ مُّحِيطٌۢ
41:54.tr: Ala innahum fee miryatin min liqai rabbihim ala innahu bikulli shayin muheet
41:54.en: Unquestionably, they are in doubt about the meeting with their Lord. Unquestionably He is, of all things, encompassing.
41:54.sw: Ama wao wamo katika shaka ya kukutana na Mola wao Mlezi! Ama hakika Yeye amekizunguka kila kitu.

54:55.h: فِي مَقۡعَدِ صِدۡقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٖ مُّقۡتَدِرِۭ ٥٥
54:55.t: فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ
54:55.en: In a seat of honor near a Sovereign, Perfect in Ability.
54:55.sw: Katika makalio ya haki kwa Mfalme Mwenye uweza.

4:85.h: مَّن يَشۡفَعۡ شَفَٰعَةً حَسَنَةٗ يَكُن لَّهُۥ نَصِيبٞ مِّنۡهَاۖ وَمَن يَشۡفَعۡ شَفَٰعَةٗ سَيِّئَةٗ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كِفۡلٞ مِّنۡهَاۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ مُّقِيتٗا ٨٥
4:85.t: مَّن يَشْفَعْ شَفَٰعَةً حَسَنَةً يَكُن لَّهُۥ نَصِيبٌ مِّنْهَا وَمَن يَشْفَعْ شَفَٰعَةً سَيِّئَةً يَكُن لَّهُۥ كِفْلٌ مِّنْهَا وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ مُّقِيتًا
4:85.tr: Man yashfa' shafa'atan hasanatan yakun lahu naseebun minha waman yashfa' shafa'atan sayyiatan yakun lahu kiflun minha wakana Allahu 'ala kulli shayin muqeeta
4:85.en: Whoever intercedes for a good cause will have a reward therefrom; and whoever intercedes for an evil cause will have a burden therefrom. And ever is Allah, over all things, a Keeper.
4:85.sw: Mwenye kusaidia msaada mwema ana fungu lake katika hayo, na mwenye kusaidia msaada mwovu naye ana sehemu yake katika hayo. Na hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mwenye uweza na ujuzi juu ya kila kitu.

8:40.h: وَإِن تَوَلَّوۡاْ فَٱعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَوۡلَىٰكُمۡۚ نِعۡمَ ٱلۡمَوۡلَىٰ وَنِعۡمَ ٱلنَّصِيرُ ٤٠
8:40.t: وَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَوْلَىٰكُمْ نِعْمَ ٱلْمَوْلَىٰ وَنِعْمَ ٱلنَّصِيرُ
8:40.tr: Wain tawallaw fa'lamoo anna Allaha mawlakum ni'ma almawla wani'ma annaseer
8:40.en: But if they turn away - then know that Allah is your protector. Excellent is the protector, and Excellent is the helper.
8:40.sw: Na kama wakigeuka basi jueni kwamba Mwenyezi Mungu ndiye Mola wenu, ni Mola Mwema na Msaidizi Mwema.

21:89.h: وَزَكَرِيَّآ إِذۡ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥ رَبِّ لَا تَذَرۡنِي فَرۡدٗا وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلۡوَٰرِثِينَ ٨٩
21:89.t: وَزَكَرِيَّآ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥ رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِى فَرْدًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْوَٰرِثِينَ
21:89.tr: Wazakariyya ith nada rabbahu rabbi la tatharnee fardan waanta khayru alwaritheen
21:89.en: And [mention] Zechariah, when he called to his Lord, "My Lord, do not leave me alone [with no heir], while you are the best of inheritors."
21:89.sw: Na Zakariya alipo mwita Mola wake Mlezi: Mola wangu Mlezi! Usiniache peke yangu, na Wewe ndiye Mbora wa wanao rithi.

2:115.h: وَلِلَّهِ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقُ وَٱلۡمَغۡرِبُۚ فَأَيۡنَمَا تُوَلُّواْ فَثَمَّ وَجۡهُ ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ وَٰسِعٌ عَلِيمٞ ١١٥
2:115.t: وَلِلَّهِ ٱلْمَشْرِقُ وَٱلْمَغْرِبُ فَأَيْنَمَا تُوَلُّوا۟ فَثَمَّ وَجْهُ ٱللَّهِ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ وَٰسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ
2:115.tr: Walillahi almashriqu walmaghribu faaynama tuwalloo fathamma wajhu Allahi inna Allaha wasi'un 'aleem
2:115.en: And to Allah belongs the east and the west. So wherever you [might] turn, there is the Face of Allah. Indeed, Allah is all-Encompassing and Knowing.
2:115.sw: Na mashariki na magharibi ni za Mwenyezi Mungu. Basi kokote mnako elekea, huko Mwenyezi Mungu yupo. Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ni mwenye wasaa na Mjuzi.

85:14.en: And He is the Forgiving, the Affectionate,
85:14.sw: Naye ni Mwenye kusamehe, Mwenye mapenzi,

3:173.h: ٱلَّذِينَ قَالَ لَهُمُ ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّ ٱلنَّاسَ قَدۡ جَمَعُواْ لَكُمۡ فَٱخۡشَوۡهُمۡ فَزَادَهُمۡ إِيمَٰنٗا وَقَالُواْ حَسۡبُنَا ٱللَّهُ وَنِعۡمَ ٱلۡوَكِيلُ ١٧٣
3:173.t: ٱلَّذِينَ قَالَ لَهُمُ ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّ ٱلنَّاسَ قَدْ جَمَعُوا۟ لَكُمْ فَٱخْشَوْهُمْ فَزَادَهُمْ إِيمَٰنًا وَقَالُوا۟ حَسْبُنَا ٱللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ ٱلْوَكِيلُ
3:173.tr: Allatheena qala lahumu annasu inna annasa qad jama'oo lakum fakhshawhum fazadahum eemanan waqaloo hasbuna Allahu wani'ma alwakeel
3:173.en: Those to whom hypocrites said, "Indeed, the people have gathered against you, so fear them." But it [merely] increased them in faith, and they said, "Sufficient for us is Allah, and [He is] the best Disposer of affairs."
3:173.sw: Walio ambiwa na watu: Kuna watu wamekukusanyikieni, waogopeni! Hayo yakawazidishia Imani, wakasema: Mwenyezi Mungu anatutosha, naye ni mbora wa kutegemewa.

42:9.h: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوۡلِيَآءَۖ فَٱللَّهُ هُوَ ٱلۡوَلِيُّ وَهُوَ يُحۡيِ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ ٩
42:9.t: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ فَٱللَّهُ هُوَ ٱلْوَلِىُّ وَهُوَ يُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
42:9.tr: Ami ittakhathoo min doonihi awliyaa fallahu huwa alwaliyyu wahuwa yuhyee almawta wahuwa 'ala kulli shayin qadeer
42:9.en: Or have they taken protectors [or allies] besides him? But Allah - He is the Protector, and He gives life to the dead, and He is over all things competent.
42:9.sw: Au wamechukua walinzi wengine badala yake! Lakini Mwenyezi Mungu ndiye Mlinzi khasa. Na Yeye ndiye anaye huisha wafu. Na Yeye ndiye Mweza wa kila kitu.

3:8.h: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغۡ قُلُوبَنَا بَعۡدَ إِذۡ هَدَيۡتَنَا وَهَبۡ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحۡمَةًۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡوَهَّابُ ٨
3:8.t: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ
3:8.tr: Rabbana la tuzigh quloobana ba'da ith hadaytana wahab lana min ladunka rahmatan innaka anta alwahhab
3:8.en: [Who say], "Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us and grant us from Yourself mercy. Indeed, You are the Bestower.
3:8.sw: (Na hao husema): Mola wetu Mlezi! Usizipotoe nyoyo zetu baada ya kwisha tuongoa, na utupe rehema itokayo kwako. Hakika Wewe ndiye Mpaji.
